content: [提出: 文獻掃描 K590, 執行: Claude, 審查: Codex] ⚠️ FLAWED: Codex 發現 3 個 HIGH bug: (1) 短期分量應是 unit-mean 無因次 GJR（r²/τ），實際寫成獨立方差過程；(2) V_m 輸入因 bug#1 也錯；(3) BIC 比較 m 值時不同 m 用不同樣本量。結果不可信。需要用正確 Conrad-Engle MF2 規格重做。

title: K622: ★★ Window Size Sensitivity — w=1000-1500 sweet spot, NOT clean U-shape
content: [提出: 文獻掃描 K590 (Feng & Zhang 2025), 執行: Claude] GJR-GARCH window sweep w∈{252-3000}，OOS 2023-2024。SPY QLIKE range 僅 1.86%。GLD 弱 U 形 min@1500。0050.TW U 形 min@1500，w≥2500 崩潰。w=1000-1500 三資產最平衡。結論：window 對 QLIKE 影響有限(<2% SPY)但對短歷史資產影響巨大。

title: K623: ⚠️ MF2-GARCH Corrected — STILL HAS BUGS (Codex: τ constraint wrong, optimizer acceptance flawed)
content: [提出: K621 Codex 審查, 執行: Claude] 修正 K621 三個 bug 後重做。MF2-GARCH(m=66) QLIKE=1.503 vs GJR 1.530，DM t=-2.03 p=0.042 顯著。但：(1) Harvey threshold t>3.0 未達；(2) 收斂率僅 25%（6/24 refits）；(3) mean g=1.37（應為 1.0，unit-mean 未完全實現）。與 K621 FLAWED 結果（QLIKE 差距 0.3%，DM p=0.64）截然不同——修正 bug 後差距擴大到 1.8%，p 值從 0.64 降到 0.042。教訓：ML/complex model 的實作 bug 可以完全改變結論（K618/K619 KAN 也是）。 ⚠️ Codex 二審發現 2 個 HIGH bug: (1) τ 約束 λ₂+λ₃<1 數學錯誤，λ₂ 非自回歸持續性，正確條件 E[τ]=(λ₁+λ₂)/(1-λ₃)。導致 τ≈1 g≈1.37。(2) Failed optimizer 可覆蓋 successful fit。結果 cautiously positive 但需 K625 第三次修正。

title: K624: HAR-PD Path-Dependent Vol — NULL at daily frequency (0/3 assets)
content: [提出: arXiv 2503.00851, 執行: Claude] 路徑依賴波動率模型（趨勢特徵 R1 + 波動記憶 R2，指數衰減核）在日頻 r² proxy 下無效。SPY: HAR-PD QLIKE=2.877 vs HAR 1.531（DM t=2.59 顯著更差）。GLD: 幾乎無差（1.474 vs 1.469）。0050.TW: GJR 最佳(1.654)。λ選擇穩定（SPY λ₁=0.1 λ₂=0.5 快衰減）。原論文用 5-min RV 中國市場有效，日頻 r² proxy 太 noisy 無法捕捉 path memory。HAR 的 5d/22d 平均已捕捉大部分路徑信息。結論：path-dependence 可能需要高頻數據，等 5-min RV 60+ 天後再測。

title: K625: Time-Varying Hurst (DFA) — NULL for forecasting, descriptive value only
content: [提出: arXiv 2509.05820 + Frontiers 2025, 執行: Claude] DFA 估計 rolling Hurst on |r_t|，w=252。Mean H=0.771，97.2% 時間 H>0.5（persistent，非 rough）。H 時變真實：COVID H=1.10，OOS H=0.64。Corr(H,VIX)=0.45。OOS 2023-2024：GJR-GARCH QLIKE=1.491 最佳，Regime-Hurst +0.17%，HAR-H +2.48%。HAR-H vs HAR 顯著更好(DM=4.15)但 HAR 整體不如 GJR。結論：Hurst 描述波動動態但無法超越 GJR 預測。|r_t| 的 H≈0.77 與 Gatheral H≈0.1 不同——後者用 log-variance increments。VIX sufficiency 再次確認（#38）。

title: K626: ★★ VIX Direction Predictability — NO economic value, confirms level-based strategy optimal
content: [提出: 策略應用探索, 執行: Claude] VIX 方向二元預測（up/down）。RF accuracy=60%（naive 'always down' 56.4%，lift 僅 3.6pp）。VIX direction autocorrelation 幾乎為零（lag-1 = -0.048）。經濟價值測試：direction-informed 12/VIX Sharpe=1.72 < 標準 12/VIX 1.81。即使 direction 可預測，調整曝險反而增加波動和回撤。Perfect foresight upper bound Sharpe=3.64。結論：VIX 近似 martingale，我們的策略正確使用 VIX level 而非 direction——設計原則經驗證。Feature importance: day_of_week(0.15), spy_5d_ret(0.12)。

title: K627: ★ Momentum+VT Hybrid — No overlay improves 12/VIX (irreducible kernel #10)
content: [提出: 策略應用探索, 執行: Claude] 測試 SMA/Dual Momentum/MACD overlay 加在 12/VIX 上。OOS 2023-2024：Baseline 12/VIX Sharpe=1.80。SMA filter Sharpe=1.56（降 MDD 0.9% 但 Sharpe -0.25）。Dual Momentum 0.99（大幅退化）。MACD Boost 1.78（幾乎相同）。Combined 1.08。50/50 SPY/GLD 2.07 仍最佳。所有 bootstrap p>0.05 不顯著。注意：OOS 期間 SMA bullish 97% 時間，動量信號幾乎沒機會觸發防禦。需 cross-OOS（含熊市）驗證。結論：12/VIX irreducible kernel 第 10 次確認。動量不能改善 VIX-based 策略。

title: K628b: ★★ Cross-Asset Vol Spillover Network — SPY dominant transmitter, 0050.TW pure receiver
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/網絡模型, 執行: Claude] Diebold-Yilmaz spillover index + Granger causality + Forbes-Rigobon contagion test，5 資產（SPY/GLD/TLT/0050.TW/USO），2010-2026。SPY 是主要傳播者（net +43.7%），0050.TW 是純接收者（OUT=0, IN=2）。高波動 regime 網絡密度翻倍（11 vs 4 Granger links）。Forbes-Rigobon：無傳染（p>0.20），只是相互依存——危機時相關性上升完全由方差增加解釋。Total spillover 均值 25.8%（9.5%-51.6%），COVID 和 2022 bear market 峰值。Spillover-informed 配置 NULL（Sharpe 1.15 vs equal weight 1.21）。論文引用價值：支持 Taiwan VT 論文的 'US lead-lag' narrative。

title: K629: Disposition Effect (CGO) — Behavioral interpretation of leverage, no incremental forecast value
content: [提出: 行為金融跳躍探索, 執行: Claude] Capital Gains Overhang (CGO) 測試。In-sample CGO beta=-0.000673 t=-2.907（<Harvey 3.0）。CGO 與 VIX 相關 -0.77，加入 VIX 後 CGO t=−0.002 完全被吸收。OOS HAR+CGO QLIKE 更差（DM t=-1.81 p=0.07 marginally）。CGO 與 252d cumret 相關 0.889——本質是慢速累積回報指標。Quintile pattern 完美（Q1 losers RV 8.4x Q5 gainers）但這就是 leverage effect。結論：disposition effect 提供行為解釋但無增量預測力。VIX sufficiency #39。可能在月頻/個股更有用。

title: K630: ★ Overnight/Intraday Decomposition — Rich descriptive, null for OOS forecasting
content: [提出: Codex 建議 #2, 執行: Claude] SPY 隔夜/日內分解。隔夜佔日方差 36.6%（COVID 期間 55.7%）。隔夜 return 強左偏(-1.44)極峰(25.9)。大幅隔夜缺口→V 形日內波動反應（負缺口 3.77x，正缺口 3.08x）。r_on 與 r_id 幾乎不相關(0.039)但 r²相關(0.206)。OOS：GJR-GARCH baseline QLIKE=1.519 最佳。HAR-OI +1.54%（NS）。GJR-X(overnight) +5.68%（marginally worse DM p=0.07）。結論：分解揭示有趣市場微結構但在 r² proxy 下無預測增量。等 5-min RV 後可能不同。

title: K631: Calendar Vol Patterns — OpEx/pre-holiday effects real but too weak for forecasting
content: [提出: K626 day_of_week importance, 執行: Claude] 8 種日曆效應（weekday/month/FOMC/OpEx/holiday/TOM/QE）× 3 資產。SPY OpEx vol 低 32.8%(p=0.01)，假期前低 23.1%(p=0.011)，Friday 低 22%(p=0.019)。Monthly KW p=0.023。但 weekday pattern 跨子期不穩定（所有 p>0.10）。OOS：HAR+calendar vs HAR QLIKE -4.4% 但 DM p=0.196（NS）。GJR+calScale -0.3% NS。GLD 無顯著效應。0050.TW weekday KW p=0.012 但 OOS 也無改善。結論：日曆效應太弱太不穩定，GJR-GARCH 已捕捉足夠。K626 的 day_of_week importance 是相關性而非因果。

title: K632: ★★ Fear DCA Optimization — Step function best (+4% per dollar invested)
content: [提出: 策略優化, 執行: Claude] Fear DCA 參數掃描（5 種 multiplier × 多組參數），SPY 2010-2026。Step function 最佳：每投入 $1 獲得 $3.43（vs 普通 DCA $3.30，+4.0%，bootstrap p<0.01）。Step 規則：VIX<15→0.5x, 15-20→1x, 20-30→1.5x, 30-40→2x, ≥40→3x。平均成本降低 3.84%（$185 vs $192/股）。Linear α=0.20 terminal wealth 最高（$851K）但需多投 30% 資金。Inverse 12/VIX 表現最差（恐慌時投太少）。Sensitivity：流動性約束（50%）效益減半但仍正；cap 2x vs 3x 差異小（VIX≥40 很罕見）。結論：Step function 是最實用的 Fear DCA——規則簡單、資金需求低、統計顯著。

title: K633: ★★★ Taiwan 0050 Strategy Optimization — 50/50 0050+GLD best (Net Sharpe 1.29)
content: [提出: 台灣投資人需求, 執行: Claude] 0050.TW 策略系統優化（6 類 × 多參數），OOS 2015-2026 月頻。最佳：50/50 0050+GLD k=10/VIX Net Sharpe=1.288 MDD=-10.6% CAGR=8.92%。現有 taiwan_8.63vix 排 #11（Net Sharpe 0.972）。交易成本（ETF 18.5bp round-trip）影響小（0.09-0.29%/年月頻）。Piecewise 不如 Simple VT（binary exit 在高波動市場有害）。重要發現：OOS amplification=1.00x（非 K530 的 4.6x），0050 年化 vol 18.3% ≈ SPY 17.4%——amplification 可能是期間特定。Fear DCA 對 0050 平手。結論：台灣投資人最佳策略是 50/50 0050+GLD（月頻調倉，k=10/VIX）。

title: K634: ★★★ GARCH Param Stability — Fixed params BEAT rolling re-estimation for SPY!
content: [提出: 方法論驗證, 執行: Claude] GJR-GARCH 參數穩定性分析（148 滾動估計 w=2000 step=21）。SPY: gamma 148/148 正（leverage 結構穩定），beta CV=0.06 最穩，alpha CV=1.12 最不穩。Persistence 0.975±0.010 極穩。CUSUM 全部 reject（參數確實漂移但緩慢）。驚人發現：固定參數 QLIKE=1.464 顯著優於滾動重估 1.492（DM p<0.001）——頻繁重估增加噪音。GLD: gamma 均值-0.013（52% 為負），無 leverage effect→應用 GARCH(1,1) 非 GJR。0050.TW: 收斂率 67%，gamma 正 79%，參數不穩定性遠高於 SPY。結論：SPY 的 21-day refit 是過度的；固定大窗口估計更好。這改變了我們的方法論假設。

title: K635: ★★ Fixed vs Rolling GARCH VT — Aligned direction but economically NS (turnover -74%)
content: [提出: K634 驗證, 執行: Claude] 固定參數 GJR-GARCH VT vs 滾動 VT。SPY OOS 2023-2024：Fixed Sharpe 1.614 vs Rolling 1.567（+0.047），QLIKE 1.464 vs 1.492（DM p<0.001）。方向一致但 Economic DM p=0.183 不顯著。主要優勢：turnover -74%（65 vs 247 次 weight change >5pp）。50/50 SPY/GLD：Fixed 1.961 vs Rolling 1.937（同向同幅度）。12/VIX 仍遠超所有 GARCH VT（Sharpe 2.65）。結論：固定參數統計上更好、實務上更穩（少交易）但經濟差異微小。Prediction≠Application 第 7 次：方向對了但幅度不夠。建議：可改為季度 refit（而非月頻），兼顧穩定性和適應性。

title: K636: ★★ Taiwan Amplification Resolved — 4.6x=gamma, 1.0x=vol level, no paper correction needed
content: [提出: K633 矛盾, 執行: Claude] N121 的 4.6x = TAIEX GJR gamma / 個股 gamma（leverage 放大），K633 的 1.0x = σ(0050)/σ(SPY)（vol 水平比）。量測不同東西，論文正確。Full sample vol ratio=1.16x，rolling [0.56x-2.01x] 高度時變。0050 gamma=0.411(t=14.85) > SPY 0.173(t=7.02)。Downside beta 0.23 = 6.5x upside beta 0.04（bootstrap p=0.033）。VIX 平靜時 vol ratio 更高（~1.6x vs crisis ~1.1x）。yfinance 0050 有 2014-01-02 stock split artifact（-139% return），需過濾。

title: K637: ★★ Vol Regime Clustering — 2 natural regimes, HMM beats VIX brackets but with IS bias caveat
content: [提出: 方法論/策略探索, 執行: Claude] Unsupervised clustering（K-Means/GMM/HMM）識別波動 regime。Silhouette 強烈支持 k=2（calm vs stressed）。固定 VIX brackets [15/20/30] silhouette 僅 0.043（vs K-Means 0.37, HMM 0.41）——不是自然邊界。HMM 2-state 策略 Sharpe 0.93-1.08 vs baseline 0.77（+0.15-0.31）。HMM 3-state：calm(49% VIX 14.3), transitional(38% VIX 21.3), crisis(13% VIX 36.3)。Calm regime Sharpe 2.31，Stressed -1.53。⚠️ 但 regime 是 full-sample fitted，有 in-sample bias。需 forward-filtering HMM 做 true OOS。K-Means/GMM 經濟測試 NS。

title: K638: VIX Term Structure Slope — Significant partial corr but no OOS value (VIX sufficiency #40)
content: [提出: 策略增強探索, 執行: Claude] VIX3M/VIX slope 分析。Slope 與 future 22d RV 相關 -0.58，partial(|VIX) -0.19（p<1e-38）——有統計增量但效果溫和。Slope Granger-causes VIX changes（p<0.001 all lags）。Backwardation(slope<0) 發生 9.6% 時間，年化 return -167% vs contango +30%（t=12.6）。OOS 2023-2024：GARCH-X(slope) QLIKE 與 baseline 相同(0.416)。HAR+slope 更差(0.573)。Strategy: slope-adjusted VT Sharpe 0.939 vs baseline 0.924（NS, p=0.584）。結論：slope 有描述/統計價值但無 OOS 預測增量。VIX sufficiency #40。

title: K639: ★★ Crypto-Equity Vol — BTC→SPY Granger, inverse leverage, NOT crisis hedge
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/加密資產, 執行: Claude] BTC-SPY vol linkage 2015-2026。Correlation regime shift：pre-2020 r=0.03 → post-2020 r=0.40（Fisher z=10.28）。BTC vol unidirectional Granger-causes SPY vol（lag 2-10 p<0.05）。BTC inverse leverage gamma=-0.038（漲比跌更 volatile，與股票相反）。BTC persistence=1.000（IGARCH）。Tail dependence 4.25x independence（joint extreme p=0.011）——BTC 不是危機避險。OOS：BTC vol 不改善 SPY vol 預測（null）。90/10 SPY/BTC Sharpe 0.83 > SPY-only 0.70 但 MDD 惡化。BTC vol ratio 從 2017 的 12.5x 降至 2025 的 2.0x（市場成熟化）。

title: K640: ★★★ Live Performance Audit — 11/14 beat benchmarks, Piecewise Sharpe 3.98
content: [提出: 實戰驗證, 執行: Claude] 15 個月 paper trading live data（2025-01 to 2026-03）審計。11/14 策略打敗 SPY(0.44) 和 60/40(0.50)。最佳 active: Piecewise Conservative Sharpe 3.98 MDD -2.5%, Taiwan Hybrid 3.76 MDD -8.5%, VIX Conditional 2.83。純 SPY VT 表現差（GARCH VT 0.26, 12/VIX 0.23）——2025 年 VIX 均值 19.2 最高 52.33(2025-04-08 tariff shock)，高 VIX 環境下 VIX-inverse 策略自然降低曝險→錯過反彈。10/14 backtest-live 一致(delta<1.0)。跨市場策略（Taiwan/TZ）live > backtest——真正 alpha。SPY MDD -18.8% vs Piecewise -2.5%（7.5x 保護）。

title: K641: ★★★ VT Regime Decomposition — Conditional architecture best, continuous scaling worst in Elevated
content: [提出: K640 follow-up, 執行: Claude] VT 策略在 4 VIX regime 的表現分解（810 days, 2023-2026）。Calm(31%) Normal(47%) Elevated(20%) Crisis(2%)。核心發現：(1) 連續 scaling（GARCH/12VIX）在 Elevated Sharpe -5.2——持有太多但不夠少。(2) Piecewise 危機零損失但 rebound 只捕 0.53/12.44%。(3) VIX Conditional Leverage 最平衡——crisis Sharpe +0.36 + rebound capture。(4) All VT 淨 regime value vs BH 為負——opportunity cost > protection benefit。(5) 2025 tariff shock：Risk Parity +7.83%, Adaptive +4.61%, GARCH VT -4.39%。結論：discrete-bracket + conditional 架構優於 continuous scaling。

title: K642: ★★ Optimal Rebalance Freq — US daily best (2bp trivial), TW monthly (18.5bp matters)
content: [提出: K634/K635 延伸, 執行: Claude] 50/50 SPY/GLD 12/VIX 策略 rebalance 頻率掃描（daily~annual + threshold-based）。US: Daily Net Sharpe 1.42（TX drag 僅 17bp/yr），Monthly 0.82，Quarterly 0.69——daily 遠優。2% threshold 保持 >95% daily Sharpe 且減少 60% 交易。TW(18.5bp)：Daily Sharpe 0.19（TX drag 127bp/yr），差異受 0050 數據品質影響。Threshold-based 在低 TX 市場優於 calendar-based；高 TX 市場 calendar(monthly)反而較好。結論：美股日頻 rebalance 成本可忽略，台股建議月頻或 2-5% threshold。

title: K643: ★★ Multi-Strategy Portfolio — Single best (Piecewise) beats all combinations
content: [提出: 策略組合探索, 執行: Claude] 6 種策略組合方法 × 8 individual strategies（809 days）。Piecewise Conservative Sharpe 3.16 獨自打敗所有組合——最佳組合 Regime Conditional 2.69（-14.7%）。原因：策略平均相關 0.72（太高），共享 SPY 曝險→無分散效益。Markowitz 自動集中 57.5% 到 Piecewise（HHI 0.82）。Best-2 momentum 64.2% 時間選 Piecewise。唯一亮點：Regime Conditional 在 H2 改善（delta +0.25），是最穩定的組合方法。結論：不需要策略組合——找到一個最佳策略即可。但如果想分散，Regime Conditional 最好。

title: K644: ★★ Session Meta-Analysis — 24 experiments, 39% null, 5 actionable improvements
content: [提出: session 總結, 執行: Claude] K621-K643 meta-analysis。24 實驗：9 null(39%), 6 positive(26%), 7 informative, 1 negative。Top findings: (1)固定 GARCH 勝滾動 DM p=4.5e-5 (2)Live audit 11/14 beat benchmarks (3)MF2 Codex 修正→顯著 (4)Multi-strategy 分散無效 (5)Window/rebalance 因資產而異。VIX sufficiency +7 confirmations this session。5 actionable improvements: Fear DCA step function, 50/50 0050+GLD for Taiwan, daily rebalance for US, 2% threshold for stability, Regime Conditional for combo。Methodology: Codex 審查改變結論（K621→K623）。

title: K645: ★★★ GLD Role Analysis — Optimal weight 20% WITH VT (not 50%), return parity not crisis hedge
content: [提出: 策略理解, 執行: Claude] GLD 在 VT 投組的角色分解。SPY-GLD corr=0.058（穩定跨 regime）。Vol reduction 27%。GLD CAGR=10.53%≈SPY 10.42%（回報貢獻而非死weight）。危機 hedge rate 僅 50%（GFC +29% 但 COVID -2.6%）。關鍵：With 12/VIX overlay，最佳 GLD 權重從 50%→20%（Sharpe 1.71 vs 50/50 的 1.40）——VT 已處理危機風險，不需要那麼多 GLD。100% SPY + 12/VIX Sharpe 1.64 > 50/50 + 12/VIX 1.40。50/50 vs 100% SPY Sharpe 差異 bootstrap p=0.101 不顯著。結論：GLD 的價值是 return + diversification，不是 crisis hedge。With VT，最佳配置是 80/20 SPY/GLD。

title: K646: ★★★ Cross-OOS confirms 80/20 > 50/50 (4/5 periods, p=0.031) but minimax favors 50/50
content: [提出: K645 驗證, 執行: Claude] 80/20 vs 50/50 SPY/GLD + 12/VIX cross-OOS（5 期間 2008-2024）。80/20 勝 4/5 期間（僅 GFC 輸）。Average Sharpe: 80/20=1.84 vs 50/50=1.40（+0.44）。Bootstrap p=0.031 顯著。但 minimax：50/50 worst-case Sharpe 0.604 > 80/20 的 0.356。100% SPY avg Sharpe 最高(1.88)但 GFC worst-case 最差(0.36)。MDD 兩者接近（avg -6.4%）但 worst MDD 80/20=-10.7% vs 50/50=-9.4%。結論：80/20 統計上顯著更好但 50/50 提供 worst-case 保護。建議分型推薦：報酬導向→80/20，風險厭惡→50/50。

title: K647: ★★ Strategy Matcher Algorithm — Piecewise Pareto dominant, profile-dependent #2/#3
content: [提出: 產品化需求, 執行: Claude] 投資人 profile→策略推薦評分系統。4 維度（Sharpe, MDD safety, simplicity, capital eligible）× profile-specific weights + 硬性過濾（市場、資金）+ 軟性懲罰（MDD excess, complexity, negative net Sharpe）。結果：Piecewise Conservative 所有 profile #1（Sharpe 3.98 + MDD -2.5% Pareto dominant）。保守型: Piecewise→50/50→VIX Cond。青年: Piecewise→50/50→Risk Parity。積極型: Piecewise→Adaptive Tier→Taiwan Hybrid。Negative net Sharpe 懲罰有效淘汰 slow_vt/12vix（TX 成本關鍵）。5/5 validation tests pass。框架可直接用於網站 StrategySelector。

title: K648: ★★ Drawdown Recovery — Piecewise 7.7% monthly loss rate, Risk Parity fastest recovery
content: [提出: K641 延伸, 執行: Claude] Drawdown 恢復速度分析（11 策略，2023-2026）。Piecewise Conservative: Ulcer 0.007（SPY 的 1/5）、月虧損率 7.7%（1月/年）、Pain-adjusted Sharpe 343.4。Risk Parity 恢復最快 avg 13 天。VIX Cond Leverage 全面 #2。SPY BH: Ulcer 0.035, 月虧損 30.8%（3月/年）。Piecewise max underwater 68 天 vs SPY 143 天。結論：檢查頻率月頻→Piecewise（最少看到虧損），快速恢復重要→Risk Parity。

title: K649: Vol-of-Vol — NULL for regime prediction, calm-before-storm rejected, VoV adjustment hurts
content: [提出: K448 延伸/regime 視角, 執行: Claude] σ_VIX/VVIX 能否預測 VIX regime 變化（crossing 20）。Best AUC=0.587（marginally above random）。σ_VIX incremental AUC bootstrap p=0.218 NS。VoV-adjusted 12/VIX Sharpe 0.527 顯著 < standard 0.680（DM p=0.005）——過度避險。Calm-before-storm 假說 rejected（storm 前 σ_VIX 不 elevated，p=0.148）。σ_VIX 是 lagging indicator。VVIX leads σ_VIX（implied>realized）。VIX sufficiency 再確認——連 vol-of-vol 都無增量。

title: K650: ★★ Knowledge Milestone 1400 — 271 experiments, VIX sufficiency 101x, 19% null rate
content: [提出: 里程碑回顧, 執行: Claude] 1399 筆知識回顧。271 unique K-experiments。VIX sufficiency 101 確認 10 例外。16 個 established facts（VIX regime 260x, leverage 131x, QLIKE ceiling 62x）。Prediction≠Application 6x confirmed。Top experiments: K560(sector rotation), K530(HAR multi-scale DM=-15.45), K551(VIX cond leverage t=7.90)。19% null rate。87 self-corrections。Average 100 entries/day。50/50 SPY+GLD robustness 61x。12/VIX effectiveness 87x。研究誠實：null results 是第二常見 tag（93 entries）。

title: K651: FRED Macro Indicators — NULL, credit spread coefficient flips sign across periods
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/宏觀, 執行: Claude] TLT momentum, HYG/LQD credit spread, bond vol, equity-bond corr 作為 SPY vol predictor。HAR-only QLIKE=1.570 勝所有 macro-augmented 模型。HAR+all macro 2.377（-51%）。Credit spread IS t=-2.19(p=0.029) 但 OOS 不存活，係數跨期翻號（不穩定）。Regime prediction AUC: macro 0.659 vs VIX-only 0.958——VIX 遠優。結論：macro 在低頻運作，daily equity vol 已被 VIX 和 past RV 完全捕捉。VIX sufficiency 再確認。

title: K652: ★★★ VIX Action Thresholds — VIX>28 best signal, dVIX>1 optimal action threshold
content: [提出: 實務應用, 執行: Claude] VIX 行動門檻系統性分析。Level: VIX crossing 28 up→+2.45% 20d(t=2.50, 76.5% win)。VIX>30 forward return +28%/yr 但 vol 46.6%。VIX spike 不是顯著 contrarian signal(p>0.2)。Mean-reversion 中位 6-9.5 天。Action threshold: dVIX>1 最實用（Net Sharpe 1.446 vs daily 1.451，但 trades 減 60%: 91/yr vs 227/yr）。Check frequency: daily 最佳(1.45)，weekly 成本 -34%(0.96)，monthly 仍可(0.86)。VIX Action Guide validated: Calm<15→92% equity, Normal 15-20→70%, Elevated 20-25→54%, High Alert 25-30→44%, Crisis>30→31%。

title: K653: ★★★ Behavior Simulation — Lazy rebalancing costs 40%, VIX-reactive deviations HELP
content: [提出: 行為金融/實務, 執行: Claude] 5 種行為偏差模擬（50/50 12/VIX，2010-2026）。最大代價：Lazy rebalancer -40% 財富（$240K, t=3.60 p<0.001）。Panic seller -11.2%（NS）。驚人：News reactor（VIX spike 時減半）Sharpe 1.97 > perfect 1.56，Terminal +$305K。Overrider（VIX>25 全現金）也更好 Sharpe 1.88。Performance chaser +$92K。結論：(1)最重要行為紀律=按時 rebalance (2)12/VIX 策略可能 under-hedge——額外 VIX-reactive 減碼有正面效果——這解釋為什麼 Piecewise Conservative 比 12/VIX 更好。

title: K654: ★★★ Piecewise Decomposition — NOT alpha, it's risk tolerance choice (19% win rate over 21 years)
content: [提出: K640/K643 深究, 執行: Claude] Piecewise Conservative 分解。假說翻轉：VIX≥20 zone 有正 return（+16-25%/yr）——被退出的區間其實賺錢。20 年 CAGR 3.1% vs 50/50 11.4%。Gains missed 788% > Losses avoided 661%（net cost -127%）。只在 4/21 年勝出（2006/2008/2022/2026，全是危機年）。Threshold sensitivity：越高（越少退出）Sharpe 越好。K640 Sharpe 3.98 是 2025 crisis-heavy 期間特定效果。結論：Piecewise 不是 alpha 策略——是風險容忍度選擇。適合低 MDD 容忍 + 短期投資人。長期應選 50/50 或 80/20。

title: K655: ★★★ Horizon Analysis — BH 60/40 SPY/GLD dominates ALL horizons on Sharpe!
content: [提出: K654 延伸, 執行: Claude] 5 策略 × 8 投資期限（1-20 年）rolling analysis。BH 60/40 SPY/GLD 在所有期限 mean Sharpe #1（0.63-0.89）。VIX overlay 策略很少超越 BH SPY（只 13-31%）。Piecewise 幾乎全部期限 Sharpe 為負。Minimax：1yr Piecewise best(-10% vs SPY -46%)，3yr 80/20+12/VIX best(-2.2%)，5yr+ BH 60/40 best。Safety：5yr+ BH 60/40 和 50/50+12/VIX 都達 100% positive return。結論：簡單 BH 60/40 是 universal winner。VIX overlay 犧牲 CAGR 換 lower vol，但 Sharpe 改善有限。Short-term minimax 是 VT 唯一優勢場景。

title: K656: ⚠️ NEEDS RE-CHECK — VT alpha claim may have same lookahead as K679
content: [提出: K654/K655 矛盾統合, 執行: Claude] 12/VIX SPY: CAGR 17.1% vs BH 60/40 11.4%, Sharpe 1.55 vs 0.69, MDD -13% vs -35%——三個維度同時改善。VT 勝 86% 年（18/21），E[value]=+4.4%/yr。CRRA utility 全部 γ(1-20) VT 勝。Crisis 期間 12/VIX 50/50 +0.4% vs BH -9.9%。K655 矛盾可能源於 rolling-window 方法學或 VT 實作差異。GARCH VT 危機表現為負(-15.4%)——VIX-based fundamentally superior。Only 12/VIX SPY passes t>2.5(p=0.018)但未達 Harvey t>3.0。結論：VIX-based VT 確實同時提供 alpha + insurance，不只是風險容忍度選擇。但 GARCH-based VT 不行。

title: K657: ★★ Synthetic Tail Hedge — Put-like payoff retains 85.6% CAGR, MDD halved
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/tail risk, 執行: Claude] 5 種 synthetic tail hedge（VIX-triggered bond rotation, dynamic safe haven, crash buffer, momentum hedge, synthetic put）。Synthetic Put（linear VIX→GLD/TLT allocation）最佳：CAGR 8.92%（BH SPY 85.6%）, Sharpe 0.815, MDD -27%（vs SPY -55%）。GFC 只虧 -2.7%（vs SPY -37%）。限制：2022 升息 TLT 拖累(-23.5% vs SPY -17.7%)。CVaR5% -1.70%（vs SPY -2.97%）。Dynamic Safe Haven 保留最多 CAGR(97.5%)但 MDD 改善最少。結論：可用 long-only ETF 近似 put payoff，但 bond-equity 正相關環境會失效。

title: K658: ★★★ VIX Mean-Reversion — Half-life 10.2d, re-enter at VIX<30 (not <20!)
content: [提出: K652 延伸, 執行: Claude] 52 個 VIX spike(>25) 分析。Half-life 10.2 天（tau=14.8d）。Median reversion to <20: 15 天。Peak VIX 強預測 reversion time(r=0.789)。Reversion phase SPY Sharpe 1.34(33.7%/yr) vs non-reversion 0.39(6.9%)。最佳 re-entry after VIX>30: VIX 跌回<30 時進場（+7.21% 60d, MDD -7.26%），顯著優於 wait VIX<20(+1.79%, t=2.91 p=0.006)。等太久錯過大部分 rebound 但不減 MDD。Half-life 在加速（-0.32d/yr, p=0.032）——非危機期 VIX 回復越來越快。

title: K659: ★★ Vol Clustering Duration — Median high-vol only 2 days, monthly rebalance misses 89%
content: [提出: K637/K658 延伸, 執行: Claude] VIX 1993-2026 vol regime 持續時間分析（8366 天）。High vol(VIX≥20) median 只有 2 天（mean 13.9，被 GFC 331 天拉高）。88.6% high-vol episodes ≤21 天→月頻 rebalance 幾乎全部錯過。VIX 永遠漸進下降：High→Normal→Low（不跳級）。Entry VIX 弱預測 duration(rho=0.33 p<0.001)。Longest low: 205d(1994-95)，longest high: 331d(2008-09 GFC)。2010s 最短 mean high duration(7d)，2000s 最長(26d)。結論：daily/weekly VT 是必要的，staged re-entry 比 binary switch 更合理。

title: K660: ★★★ Complete Evidence-Based Investor Guide — 3 profiles, 7 principles, all traceable
content: [提出: session 總結/產品化, 執行: Claude] 綜合 17 個實驗（K632-K659）的完整投資人指南。Guide A（初學者 $5K）: 80/20 SPY/GLD + weekly VIX check, CAGR 17.1% Sharpe 1.55 MDD -13%。Guide B（保守型 $100K）: Piecewise, live Sharpe 3.98 MDD -2.5%, 但犧牲 ~8.3%/yr CAGR。Guide C（最佳化 $50K+）: 12/VIX 100% SPY daily, re-enter VIX<30 not <20, dVIX>1 threshold。7 universal principles: (1)VIX is sufficient (2)daily VT essential (3)rebalance discipline=最大行為紀律 (4)GLD 20% with VT (5)Fear DCA step function (6)re-enter VIX<30 (7)VT=alpha+insurance。

title: K661: ★★ NFP Pre-Event — Vol 1.17x normal, VIX>25 effect vanishes, 04/03 high-risk
content: [提出: P0 事件準備, 執行: Claude] 195 NFP 事件分析。NFP 日|r_SPY|=0.83% vs 正常 0.71%（1.17x, p=0.037）。VIX NFP 日下降 65.5%（不確定性消除）。VIX 15-20 時 NFP +30% vol(p=0.009)，VIX≥25 時差異消失(0.95x)——已經很 volatile。VIX 25-35 時 NFP |move|=1.56%，mean return -0.60%（偏空）。Pre-NFP: T-2 VIX 顯著下降-0.30(p=0.004)。Post-NFP: 5d drift +0.34%(p=0.038)。04/03 specific: VIX~27，歷史同級 NFP 偏空。

title: K662: ★ Commodity VT — VIX irrelevant for GLD/USO, framework doesn't transfer
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/商品, 執行: Claude] VT 框架應用於 GLD/USO。VIX 對商品 vol R²：SPY 0.681 >> USO 0.315 >> GLD 0.133。12/VIX 反而傷害 GLD（Sharpe 0.43 vs BH 0.52）。GLD 自身 vol VT 微幅改善(+0.058)但 NS(p>0.18)——因為 target vol=20%≈base vol 16.5%，weights 幾乎不變。USO VT 大幅減 MDD(95%→60%)但無法拯救結構性虧損(-61.4%)。GLD gamma=-0.04（inverted），USO gamma=+0.06。結論：VT 為股票設計，不轉移到商品。GLD 不需要 VT（VIX 與 GLD 幾乎不相關），USO 需要但拯救不了 contango。

title: K663: ★★ Rate Environment — GLD fails in rising rates, 80/20 vs 50/50 explained by rates
content: [提出: 利率分析, 執行: Claude] 利率環境對 VT 策略影響。升息(6m yield Δ>50bp)：GLD-based 50/50 Sharpe 0.265 << SPY-only 0.646。降息：50/50 Sharpe 1.311 大勝。TLT 60/40 在升息 Sharpe -0.040 MDD -26.5%。80/20 升息+穩定勝 50/50，但降息大輸(-0.611)——K646 80/20 wins 4/5 OOS 因為 4 期大多是升息/穩定。SPY-GLD 相關在升息轉正(+0.175)。SPY-TLT 從降息-0.534→升息+0.023。結論：GLD 不是全天候避險——只在降息環境有效。TLT 更差。

title: K664: ★★★ MDD Probability — Piecewise P(>10%)=5.3%, 50/50+VT P(>20%)=0%
K665: ★★★ Lookup Table Strategy — 3-row table retains 97.4% Sharpe, 10x fewer trades
content: [提出: 產品化/簡化, 執行: Claude] 12/VIX 連續公式簡化為 lookup table。Table B（3 行）：VIX<15→100%, 15-25→50%, >25→20%。Sharpe 0.703 vs continuous 0.722（retention 97.4%），weight changes 23/yr vs 231/yr（10x 減少）。Table A（5 行）甚至勝過 continuous（102.8%）。反直覺：越細越差（7 行 92.9%）——粗略離散化恰好產生更好的平均配置。VIX Action Card: 3 行 table 是最簡單的實用工具——貼在螢幕上，看 VIX 查表即可。SPY-only 時 Table B 甚至 107.1% retention。

title: K666: VIX Seasonality — NOT significant (KW p=0.97), VIX level >> calendar month
content: [提出: K631 延伸, 執行: Claude] 34 年 VIX 月份季節性。KW p=0.97 不顯著。October 最高 vol(24.1%)但統計不顯著。Sell in May p=0.32 NS（post-2010 更弱 p=0.66）。Seasonal VT overlay Sharpe 1.71 < plain 1.88（反而更差）。Entry month 差異僅 1.14pp（Feb 12.5% vs May 11.4%）。VIX 水平遠比月份重要：VIX≥20 entry→+15.5%/yr vs VIX<20→+10.5%。結論：不要看日曆投資——看 VIX。

title: K667: ★★★ Insurance Cost — 50/50+VT costs 1.33%/yr for 43.7pp MDD reduction, 10x cheaper than puts
content: [提出: K656 量化, 執行: Claude] VT 保險成本分析。12/VIX SPY premium=2.50%/yr（BH 8.30% vs VT 5.80%），break-even 需 crisis 每 2.2yr（實際每 5yr——偏貴）。50/50+VT premium=1.33%/yr，MDD 改善 43.7pp，break-even 每 25.5yr——基本上永遠划算。Cost per 1% MDD reduction：50/50+VT 0.030% 最低。vs Options：VT 2.50%/yr vs ATM put 26.1%（10x 便宜），≈10% OTM put 2.0%（相當）但無到期、無對手風險。Crisis 時 VT 賺 -43%/yr annualized。結論：50/50+VT 是投資人能買到的最便宜保險。

title: K668: ★★★ Retirement VT — Sequence risk corr 0.96→0.31, worst-case floor +36pp
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/退休金融, 執行: Claude] $1M 退休模擬 4% withdrawal，5 策略。100% survival（2006-2026 期間所有策略都活 20 年）。VT 核心價值：sequence-of-returns risk 相關性 BH SPY 0.961→50/50+VT 0.307（幾乎解耦）。Worst-case min portfolio：50/50+VT $776K(78%) vs BH SPY $421K(42%)——floor +36pp。GFC stress（Sep 2008 start）：VT 3yr MDD -10% vs BH -48%。BH terminal wealth 更高（$2.5-5M vs $1-1.6M）——VT 犧牲 upside 換 downside protection。Sustainable withdrawal rate VT ~10% vs BH 12%（都遠超 4% rule）。結論：VT 對風險厭惡退休人士有巨大價值——不是最大化財富，是最小化耗盡風險。

title: K669: ★★ Global VT — VIX is global fear signal, MDD protection universal, Sharpe only SPY
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/國際, 執行: Claude] 12/VIX on SPY/EFA/EWJ/EEM。VIX 與非美 vol 相關 0.609-0.762——全球恐慌指標。MDD 改善 4/4 市場（SPY +19pp, EFA +11pp, EWJ +13pp, EEM +0.3pp→vol-adj +11pp）。Sharpe 改善只有 SPY（1/4）。EEM 12/VIX 反而顯著更差（-0.181）。Vol-adjusted VT（target=12×vol_SPY/vol_asset）大幅改善非美：EFA gap -0.103→-0.019。Global EW: vol-adj VT Sharpe 0.514≈BH 0.521，但 MDD -31→-17%。Crisis 保護 universal（COVID +13-20pp）。結論：VIX 全球有效但 12/VIX 參數需因市場調整。

title: K670: ★★ VT+DCA Ultimate — Fear DCA best IRR (13.6%), VIX Table best MDD (-22.5%), don't combine
content: [提出: 產品化/實務, 執行: Claude] 6 種月頻 DCA 策略（$1K/月，2010-2026）。Fear DCA IRR 13.6% $3.43/dollar 最佳報酬。VIX Table DCA MDD -22.5%（vs plain -33.4%，-11pp）最佳風控。Combined VIX Table+Fear 反而更差——cash-hoarding 抵銷 aggressive buying（內部矛盾）。Lump Sum 終端值 +71% 但多數人沒有一次投入能力。60/40 DCA 是中庸選擇。結論：報酬導向→Fear DCA，風控導向→VIX Table DCA，不要合併。

title: K671: VIX Roll Yield Signal — NULL (leverage artifact), look-ahead bias caught and fixed
content: [提出: K638 延伸, 執行: Claude] Contango/backwardation signal for 12/VIX。初始結果 Sharpe 2.37 看似驚人——但有 look-ahead bias（same-day signal+return）。修正 lag-1 後 Sharpe 0.60。Combined strategy delta vs leverage-matched=+0.064 NW t=0.37 NS。Cross-OOS 只贏 2/6（33%）。Contango>5% 出現 76.5% 時間——幾乎是 constant leverage boost 不是 signal。Contango 與 future return 相關 r=-0.017 NS。結論：VIX term structure shape 不加值。重要教訓：初始好結果→立刻檢查 lag/look-ahead。

title: K672: ★★★ Definitive Conclusions — 7 proven, 6 strong, 5 emerging, 7 open questions
content: [提出: 研究總結, 執行: Claude] 1421 知識條目終極整理。Category A（定論 7）：VIX sufficiency 103+, 12/VIX kernel 178 entries, Pred≠App, QLIKE ceiling, leverage universality rho=1.000, GJR dominance DM t=-6.27, VT crisis protection 10/10。Category B（強證據 6）：50/50 robustness, monthly rebalance, target vol irrelevance, EGARCH instability, VIX weekday, Taiwan VT。Category C（新興 5）：fixed>rolling DM p=4.5e-5, Fear DCA +4%, VT=alpha+insurance, Piecewise -13.7%, gamma-trend mechanism。Category D（單一 5）：half-life 10.2d, BTC inverse leverage, 3-row table, amplification, multi-step convergence。Open questions 7。Meta: simplicity wins, null results majority, Harvey catches false positives。

title: K673: ★★★ VIX Markov Chain — VIX=28→44.8% below 20 in 1 month, crisis→31d to Normal
content: [提出: K658/K659 量化, 執行: Claude] 5-state VIX Markov chain（8366 天 1993-2026）。Calm persistence 93.1%/day, Crisis 88.2%。Calm→Crisis 164 天 vs Crisis→Calm 60 天（2.73x 不對稱）。VIX=28: 44.8% 一個月回<20。VIX=12: 79.8% 一年內 crisis。Steady-state: Calm 33.4%, Normal 28.3%, Elevated 20.0%, High 9.7%, Crisis 8.6%。Crisis expected 31 天回 Normal。Non-adjacent jumps = 0%（Calm 不直接到 Crisis）。Sub-period stable（Frobenius 0.206）。Decision tree: crisis→不要 panic sell，等 31 天。

title: K674: ★★ Crisis Scenarios — Piecewise avg DD -0.9% across 5 crises vs BH -35.9%
content: [提出: 投資人溝通, 執行: Claude] 5 歷史危機情境（GFC/COVID/Rate Shock/Slow Bear/Flash Crash）× 4 策略。Piecewise avg DD -0.9%（$100K 虧$1,625），50/50+VT -8.8%（$13,803），12/VIX -18.2%（$28,951），BH SPY -35.9%（$57,165）。Piecewise 4/5 crisis 正收益。50/50+VT 3/5 正收益（最佳中庸）。12/VIX GFC 最大虧損 -28.5%（仍比 BH -55.2% 好很多）。COVID V 型：Piecewise 只捕 +1.8% vs BH +8.9%。Rate shock：GLD 拖累（-15%）但 VT 仍勝 BH。

title: K675: ★★★ Wealth Inequality — Panic selling costs 76% wealth, anti-panic = highest ROI education
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/社會影響, 執行: Claude] 4 投資人原型模擬（$50K, 20yr）。Uninformed（panic sell）$86K, Basic（60/40）$419K, VT-Aware $221K, Optimal $189K。Panic selling 28 次損失 $276K（76%）。Gini 0.282→uninformed 升級 basic 後降 37%。危機時差距擴大最多（GFC +13pp）。Lookup table（literacy 3/5）比 12/VIX continuous（4/5）更簡單且 MDD 更好（-10.4% vs -12.3%）。Basic 60/40 raw return 最高（$419K）因 SPY+GLD 20yr 都很好。結論：最高 ROI 金融教育 = 教人不要 panic sell。VT 知識可以 democratize 但不能替代基本紀律。

title: K676: ★★ Tax Optimization — Annual rebalance saves $22K, tax-loss harvesting useless
content: [提出: K604 延伸, 執行: Claude] 5 種 tax-aware VT 策略。Annual rebalance 最佳 CAGR(7.24%) terminal($311K)——vs daily $226K 多 $85K。Tax drag: annual 18.6% vs daily 40.9%。Tax-loss harvesting 只省 $43（wash sale rule 限制）。Threshold+tax-aware MDD 最低(-11.4%)且省 $12K 稅——最佳風險調整。稅拖累 18.6-40.9% initial capital over 16yr。結論：US 投資人應盡量持有 >1 年獲取 LTCG 15%（vs STCG 22%）。台灣投資人無此問題（0% 資本利得稅）。

title: K677: ★★ VIX as Economic Indicator — 88% false positive for recession, but excellent risk signal
content: [提出: 跳躍探索/宏觀, 執行: Claude] VIX 預測衰退能力分析（1993-2026，3 NBER recessions）。VIX>25 持續 10d+ 作為衰退信號：精確度僅 12%（3/25），88% false positive。Yield curve inversion 60% 精確度——遠優。COVID 無預警（VIX 3 月前 13.4）。False positive 反而是買入機會（中位數 12M return +19%）。Annual VIX 預測 next-year SPY r=0.04 NS——零預測力。VIX>20 annualized SPY -20% vs ≤20 +31%（51pp 差距）——VT 迴避的是差勁環境不是衰退。結論：VT 不預測衰退，預測差勁的風險/報酬 regime。

title: K678: ★ Strategy Correlation — Best pair TW+JP TZ + Adaptive Tier (Sharpe 4.14, r=0.13)
content: [提出: K643 延伸, 執行: Claude] 14 策略完整相關矩陣（91 pairs）。Avg corr=0.417（比 K643 的 0.72 低因包含台灣策略）。Most corr: GARCH VT x 12/VIX r=0.991。Least corr: Taiwan VT x Taiwan Hybrid r=0.019。Most independent: Taiwan Hybrid（avg r=0.208）。Best 2-combo: TW+JP TZ + Adaptive Tier Sharpe=4.14 r=0.133——低相關不等於最佳組合，需同時有高個別 Sharpe。VIX regime effect: avg corr change 僅 -0.002，但個別 pair 大幅波動（±0.6）。

title: K679: ⚠️ VIX Percentile — Codex: same-day lookahead + t-test not DM. Needs K686 correction.
content: [提出: 策略創新, 執行: Claude] VIX percentile(rolling 252d) 取代 absolute 12/VIX。w = 1 - VIX_percentile。Sharpe 1.680 vs 12/VIX 1.079（+56%），t=3.375 p<0.01 通過 Harvey threshold！MDD -6.74% vs -9.04%。Sortino 2.24 vs 1.57。CAGR 15.4% vs 12.4%。全部 4 sub-period 都勝。機制：避免 VIX=11 全力投入（percentile 知道 11 是 normal 不是低），避免 VIX=30 完全退出（如果最近都是 30+，percentile 知道這不是極端）。Z-score 版本也顯著（t=5.61）但 MDD 較差(-13.4%)。Adaptive 12/VIX 無改善。這是本研究計畫最重要的策略創新之一——可能改變我們的預設策略。 ⚠️ Codex審查: (1)same-day lookahead(VIX_t→同日return, 應為t+1) (2)t=3.375是paired t-test非DM test且在gross return (3)rolling window include/exclude不一致。Relative comparison可能仍有效但需K686修正驗證。

title: K680: ⚠️ OVERTURNED — Cross-OOS validation was on lookahead-biased results
content: [提出: K679 驗證, 執行: Claude] VIX percentile cross-OOS 5 期間全勝（GFC +0.77, Recovery +0.71, Low Vol +0.28, COVID +0.46, Post-Hike +0.15）。Avg diff +0.47。DM t=3.157 p=0.0016 Harvey PASS。Bootstrap 95% CI [+0.35, +0.83] 不含零 p=0.000。Rolling Sharpe percentile 更高 96.4% 的時間。Sensitivity: 126d/252d/504d 全部 5/5 wins。Turnover 2.11x 但 cost 只增加 ~0.45%/yr at 5bps。結論：VIX percentile 策略通過最嚴格驗證——應成為新預設策略推薦。

title: K681: ★★★ Percentile Global — 4/4 markets win, EFA t=5.419 strongest, Taiwan NS
content: [提出: K679/K680 延伸, 執行: Claude] VIX percentile on 4 markets。US Sharpe 1.68(t=3.13), EFA 1.84(t=5.42 Harvey PASS!), 0050.TW 0.27(NS t=0.29), TW+GLD 0.36(NS)。EFA 差距最大(+1.01)——歐洲市場受益最多。台灣不顯著因 TX cost 18.5bp + 高波動稀釋信號。Sub-period: EFA 3/3 穩健。結論：percentile 優勢不限美國，是 global phenomenon。非美市場（特別是 EFA）受益甚至更大。

title: K682: Percentile Lookup Table — P3-AGG (3-row) beats 12/VIX, K665 Table A still best overall
content: [提出: K679 簡化, 執行: Claude] Percentile-inspired lookup table。VIX percentile thresholds: 25th=13.7, 50th=17.1, 75th=22.5, 90th=28.8（但 CV=16.7% 不夠穩定）。7 個 table 排名：K665 Table A(5-row) Sharpe 0.74 最佳，P3-AGG(3-row <15→80%, 15-25→45%, >25→10%) 0.73 第二。True percentile 在同框架下其實 0.64 < 12/VIX 0.69——K679 的優勢可能來自不同的 cash return 假設。P3-AGG 是最簡單能打敗 12/VIX 的 table。但統計上無 table 通過 Harvey t>3.0。

title: K683: ★★★ Percentile vs Piecewise — Percentile wins composite 11/35, DM t=3.74 Harvey PASS
content: [提出: 策略比較, 執行: Claude] 5 策略 7 指標 head-to-head。Composite rank: Percentile 11/35 #1, Piecewise 14/35 #2。Percentile: Sharpe 1.68, CAGR 15.4%, MDD -6.7%。Piecewise: Sharpe 1.48, CAGR 11.1%, MDD -4.9%。DM daily return t=3.74 p=0.0002 Harvey PASS——統計上不同。但 bootstrap Sharpe diff CI [-0.15, +0.56] 含零（p=0.134）——Sharpe 差不顯著。Regime: Percentile 在 calm/elevated/crisis 全勝。Piecewise crisis 零損失但也零收益。結論：報酬導向→Percentile（新 default），風險厭惡→Piecewise，簡單→P3-AGG lookup。

title: K684: ⚠️ Percentile Implementation — Codex: lookahead + DM on gross + mixed proxy. Needs correction.
content: [提出: K679 產品化, 執行: Claude] 完整實作規格。Lookback: 126d Sharpe 1.79(best) 但 252d 1.63 更穩定。Rebalance: daily+2%thresh 最佳（-31% trades, -0.02 Sharpe）。Weekly/monthly 大幅退化。Allocation: 70/30 SPY/GLD Sharpe 2.25, 50/50 1.63, 100/0 2.63（但不分散）。Floor 5% 微幅降 Sharpe 但增安全。Cash return 0-5% 都勝 12/VIX。最佳組合：252d, 2%thresh, floor 5%, 70/30→Sharpe 2.16 CAGR 18.7% MDD -4.8% DM t=6.80 Harvey PASS。策略規格：vix_percentile_5050, w=1-percentile(VIX,252d), daily+2%thresh, [0.05,1.00]。 ⚠️ Codex審查同K679: lookahead + DM on gross + 70/30 vs 50/50 mixed proxy比較不公平。

title: K685: ⚠️ OVERTURNED — Live sim based on lookahead-biased strategy
content: [提出: K684 驗證, 執行: Claude] 2025-2026 live period 模擬。Percentile 70/30 Sharpe 3.57 > Piecewise 2.79 > 12/VIX -0.16。MDD: Pct70 -2.26% < Piecewise -2.48%。VIX=52 shock: Pct50 完全退出(w=0)，Pct70 保持 5% floor。Recovery: 59d 回到 50% weight。Mar 2026 selloff: Pct -0.60% vs SPY -7.31%。DM tests NS（309d 太短）。P3-AGG Sharpe 2.20 也不錯。結論：Percentile 在 live period 也是 #1——backtest + live 一致。可以上架。

title: K686: ★★★★★ Percentile OVERTURNED — Advantage was 100% lookahead artifact!
content: [提出: K679 Codex修正, 執行: Claude] K679 percentile Sharpe 1.68→修正lag後0.355（-1.325）。12/VIX也降但較少(1.08→0.43, -0.65)。修正後 Percentile LOSES to 12/VIX（0.355 vs 0.431）。DM t=-1.20 p=0.23 NS。Cross-OOS只贏1/5。Bootstrap CI [-0.32,+0.16] 含零。原因：VIX_t signal 用在同日 return = lookahead。Percentile 比 12/VIX 更依賴 same-day info（rolling window ranking vs simple division）。教訓：(1)任何策略必須 lag signal 1 天 (2)好得不像真的→通常不是真的 (3)Codex 審查又一次拯救了錯誤結論（K618/K619→K621/K623→K679/K686 三次）。

title: K687: ★★★★★ DEFINITIVE RANKING — No VT beats BH 50/50 on Sharpe after proper lag!
content: [提出: K686 後清算, 執行: Claude] 7 策略全部正確 lag（signal t-1, return t），NET 5bp TX。BH 50/50 Sharpe 0.545 #1。EWMA 0.525 #2（NS diff p=0.096）。12/VIX 0.438 #3。Percentile 0.355。Piecewise 0.068（最差）。Cross-OOS：全部 FAIL（0-1/5）。VT 真正價值=drawdown control：MDD BH -32% vs 12/VIX -12% vs P3-AGG -8%。P3-AGG Calmar 0.732 最佳（drawdown-adjusted）。結論：VT 是保險（減 drawdown）不是 alpha（增 Sharpe）。K654 對了，K656 需重查。Codex 審查 → lag 修正 → 整個 paradigm shift。研究誠實：好結果被推翻也如實報告。

title: K688: ★★★ CRRA Lag-Corrected — VT wins utility at gamma≥5, EWMA VT best
content: [提出: K687 後驗證, 執行: Claude] 正確 lag 後 CRRA utility。EWMA VT gamma≥5 開始勝 BH 50/50（CE +0.19%@γ=5, +2.20%@γ=10）。12/VIX 和 P3-AGG gamma≥10 才勝。Bootstrap: γ=10 P(VT>BH)=91.7%，γ=20 100%（CI excludes zero）。GFC 期間 BH CE=-39.1% vs 12/VIX -11.2%——VT 在 crash 時 utility 差距巨大。Bull market BH dominates。結論：K687 的 'no alpha' 結論成立但不完整——VT 對 γ≥5 投資人有真正 utility value。VT=insurance 且這保險對風險厭惡者物有所值。

title: K689: ★★★★★ Paper Trading Lookahead — live returns use same-day VIX×return (corr=0.9999)
content: [提出: K687 矛盾調查, 執行: Claude] Live Sharpe(3.98) vs backtest(0.068) 差距調查。corr(live, same-day)=0.9999 確認 paper_trading.json 回填用同日 VIX×同日 return——lookahead。Piecewise 受影響最大（sharp discontinuity at VIX=12/20）：正確 lag 後 Sharpe 3.16→1.62。12/VIX 幾乎不受影響（weight 平滑，w_T≈w_{T-1}）。分解：full-sample lag 0.48 + period selection +1.14 + lookahead +1.54 = 3.16。Fix needed: daily_update.py backfill 需用 next-day return。

title: K690: ★★★ Weight Smoothness — EWMA most lag-robust (0.756), Piecewise most fragile (0.046)
content: [提出: K689 延伸, 執行: Claude] 5 策略 lag robustness ratio（Sharpe lag=1/lag=0）。EWMA VT 0.756（autocorr 0.9897，最穩健）。12/VIX 0.399。P3-AGG 0.297。Percentile 0.211。Piecewise 0.046（幾乎歸零）。相關：weight autocorr r=+0.56，mean|dw| r=-0.80。Lag=0 Sharpe 最高的策略（Piecewise 1.46, Percentile 1.68）恰好是 lookahead 最嚴重的——它們的'好表現'依賴即時 VIX 信號。Lag 後全部 cluster 在 0.35-0.53。結論：實務上 EWMA VT 最適合因為對 timing imprecision 最 forgiving。

title: K691: ★★★★★ Session Synthesis — 71 experiments, VT=insurance not alpha, EWMA most robust
content: [提出: session 總結, 執行: Claude] 71 實驗：8 overturned(11%), 15 null(21%), 48 positive(69%)。5 surviving conclusions: (1)No VT alpha after lag (2)VT utility gamma≥5 (3)EWMA most lag-robust (4)Fear DCA +4% (5)Fixed>rolling GARCH。3 lessons: (1)lookahead #1 threat（K679 污染 7 實驗）(2)Codex 審查 3 次拯救 (3)simplicity wins。Updated framework: BH 50/50 default，gamma≥5→EWMA VT，gamma≥10→P3-AGG。Next session: fix daily_update backfill, HAR-RV 5min, NFP 04/03。

title: K692: ★★★ Paper Trading Verification — daily_update.py CORRECT, historical backfill HAS lookahead
content: [提出: K689 驗證, 執行: Claude] 驗證 paper_trading.json lag convention。結果：TWO POPULATIONS。歷史條目(801筆 2023-2026/3/16): corr(same-day)=1.000——確認 lookahead（backtest seeded 時用同日 return）。新格式條目(9筆 2026/3/17+): corr(next-day)=0.999——daily_update.py 正確。結論：(1)不要改 daily_update.py（production 正確）(2)歷史 801 筆 portfolio_return 有 lookahead（performance 指標 overstated）(3)需要重新回填歷史條目（shift return 1 天）。K689 部分正確：lookahead 存在但不在 production code，在 historical seed data。

title: K693: ★★★★★ Historical Returns FIXED — 9,935 entries corrected, avg Sharpe -0.62
content: [提出: K692 修正, 執行: Claude] 修正 paper_trading.json 801 筆歷史 lookahead。9,935 entries fixed（跨 12 策略）。Sharpe 變化：Piecewise 3.16→1.56(-1.60), Adaptive 3.02→1.51(-1.51), TW+JP 3.03→1.63(-1.40), VIX Cond 2.64→1.76(-0.88)。平滑策略受影響小：slow_vt -0.07, risk_parity -0.05, 12/VIX -0.04。與 K690 lag robustness ratio 完全一致——weight 不平滑的策略 lookahead inflation 最大。Backup saved。Metrics recalculated。

title: K694: ★★★ Corrected Live Audit — 7/10 still beat SPY, ranking reshuffled
content: [提出: K693 驗證, 執行: Claude] K693 修正後重新 live audit。Avg Sharpe inflation +0.74。最膨脹：Adaptive +2.04(121%), Piecewise +2.01(103%), Taiwan Hybrid +1.74(86%)。最不受影響：Fear DCA -0.003, 12/VIX -0.16。排名變化：Risk Parity #9→#5(+4), Taiwan VT #8→#4(+4), Piecewise #4→#7(-3), Adaptive #6→#10(-4)。修正後 7/10 仍勝 SPY（avg Sharpe 1.49）——平台核心價值成立。Smooth weight 策略（12/VIX, Fear DCA）幾乎不受影響——與 K690 一致。

title: K695: EWMA Optimal Lambda — 0.98 best but NS vs 0.94, still can't beat BH 50/50
content: [提出: K690 延伸, 執行: Claude] EWMA lambda sweep {0.88-0.99} lag-corrected。λ=0.98 Sharpe 0.507 > λ=0.94 0.484 但 NS（bootstrap CI含零）。Higher λ→higher lag robustness（0.88:0.874→0.98:0.971）+ lower turnover。No λ beats BH 50/50(0.545)。Cross-OOS 1/5 wins only。MDD: λ=0.97 -16.75% vs BH -32.49%（減半）。結論：λ=0.94→0.98 微改善但 VT 仍是 insurance 不是 alpha。

title: K696: ★★ Minimum Exposure Floor — No floor beats BH on Sharpe, Calmar peaks at 20%
content: [提出: K687 延伸, 執行: Claude] 12/VIX 50/50 minimum floor sweep {0-70%} lag-corrected。Sharpe 單調增加（floor↑→接近 BH→Sharpe↑）。No floor beats BH 0.545。Best: floor 70% Sharpe 0.506（still -0.039 vs BH, t=-2.72 p=0.007）。MDD 單調惡化（floor↑→更多曝險→更大 MDD）。Calmar 在 floor 20% 最佳(0.598 vs BH 0.342)——drawdown-adjusted 最佳。GFC: floor 0% -4.15% vs BH -13.77% 但 recovery +11.6% vs +30.1%。結論：VT 的 recovery cost > crisis benefit on Sharpe basis。Calmar 是 VT 唯一優勢指標。

title: K697: ★★★★★ Alpha Upper Bound — VIX predicts vol(0.57) NOT direction(0.04), daily alpha impossible
content: [提出: 終極問題, 執行: Claude] 是否存在任何 daily alpha（lag-corrected）？SPY lag-1 autocorr=-0.105（negative = contrarian, not momentum）。VIX-direction corr=0.042（近零）。Oracle VIX(20bins ex-post) Sharpe 1.14 gross → 0.73 net（TX kills it）。Smooth oracle 0.85 < BH 0.86。No-lag oracle 5.60 >>> any lagged <1.15——1 天 lag 消滅 80% alpha。結論：(a) VT fundamentally limited at daily frequency。VIX 知道多少波動但不知道方向。Daily alpha 理論存在但被 lag 消滅。VT 唯一可靠價值 = drawdown/Calmar 改善。

title: K698: ⚠️ Contrarian VT — Codex: BH baseline wrong, TX undercount, optimization snooping
content: [提出: K697 contrarian lead, 執行: Claude] SPY lag-1 autocorr=-0.107(t=-7.41)。Contrarian tilt(BH 50/50 ±20% on >1% moves) NET Sharpe 0.878 vs BH 0.843(+0.035)。Best config: threshold 2% tilt ±30% NET 0.941 turnover 10.4x。MDD -24.8% vs -32.5%。Big down days(>1%) mean next-day return +43.9%/yr(t=2.10 p=0.036)。Bull market 微輸(1.46 vs 1.50)，crisis 勝(0.86 vs 0.69)。VIX+contrarian gross 最高(1.021) 但 TX kills it。需 cross-OOS 驗證——+0.035 可能是 noise。

title: K699: Contrarian Cross-OOS — Default FAIL 3/5, Optimized MARGINAL 4/5 (Harvey FAIL t=2.19)
content: [提出: K698 驗證, 執行: Claude] Default(1%/±20%) 3/5 FAIL。Optimized(2%/±30%) 4/5 PASS but Harvey t=2.19 FAIL。Alpha regime-dependent: corr(alpha, neg-autocorr)=-0.873。Low-vol periods 無效。Codex審查: K698 有多個 bug(BH baseline非真BH、TX undercount、NaN bug、in-sample optimization)。+0.035 alpha 不可信。結論：contrarian mean-reversion 存在但太小且不穩健——不足以成為策略推薦。

title: K700: ★★★★★ FINAL TRUTH — 80 experiments, 3 certainties, 3 mistakes caught, VT=insurance
content: [提出: 里程碑 #700, 執行: Claude] 80 experiments: 54 positive, 15 null, 8 overturned, 3 Codex-corrected。3 certainties: (1)VIX predicts vol(0.57) not direction(0.04) (2)BH 50/50 highest lag-corrected Sharpe(0.545) (3)VT MDD reduction for γ≥5。3 mistakes: K679 lookahead 4.7x inflation, K693 9935 entries fixed, K698 BH baseline bug。4 recommendations: passive→BH 50/50, γ≥5→EWMA VT, DCA→Fear step, Taiwan→monthly 50/50 0050+GLD。Codex: 4 reviews 4 catches 3 false breakthroughs prevented (37.5% false positive rate without review)。Paradigm: VT=insurance not alpha。

title: K701: ★★ Weekly/Monthly Alpha — ALSO impossible, VIX direction corr ~0 at all frequencies
content: [提出: K697 延伸, 執行: Claude] VIX-direction corr: daily 0.031, weekly 0.033, monthly 0.019——全部接近零。Direction accuracy: 50.8%/52.6%/53.9%（coin flip）。Alpha vs BH: daily -0.10, weekly -0.06, monthly +0.02(t=0.11 NS)。Lag 在低頻相對更小但 signal 也更弱——兩者抵消。VIX forward return corr 隨 horizon 微增（1d:0.031→63d:0.093）但仍極弱。結論：K697 結論在所有頻率成立。VT 在任何頻率都不產生 alpha，只產生 MDD protection。

title: K702: ★★ Optimal Static Allocation — 50/50 SPY/GLD confirmed best, grid search validated
content: [提出: post-alpha 新方向, 執行: Claude] 8 靜態配置+grid search。50/50 SPY/GLD Sharpe 0.548 #1（grid search confirm）。40/30/30 SPY/GLD/TLT Calmar 最佳(0.395) MDD -22.9%。Markowitz/Risk Parity 不如 naive 50/50（DeMiguel 2009 1/N rule）。TLT CAGR 2.89% 拖累。60/40 SPY/GLD Sharpe 0.536 #2。Cross-OOS 無單一配置 dominate all periods。結論：50/50 SPY/GLD 是最佳 2-asset static mix；若要更低 MDD 可加 30% TLT。

title: K703: ★★ Ten Numbers — Everything we know in 10 verified data points
content: [提出: 產品化, 執行: Claude] 10 個數字總結 82 實驗：0.04(VIX-direction), 0.545(BH Sharpe), -50%(MDD reduction), 5(CRRA γ), 7.7%(monthly loss), +4%(Fear DCA), 10.2d(VIX half-life), 0.99(EWMA autocorr), 37.5%(false positive w/o Codex), 82(experiments 10% overturned)。每個數字有 source experiment + verified value + practical implication。可直接用於網站 About 頁面。

title: K704: ★★ Risk Parity ≈ 50/50 because SPY vol ≈ GLD vol (19.3% vs 18.3%)
content: [提出: K702 深究, 執行: Claude] RP avg SPY weight=49.8%（與 50/50 差 0.2%）。SPY vol 19.3% ≈ GLD 18.3%（ratio 1.055）→ RP 自然收斂到 50/50。RP Sharpe 0.516 < 50/50 0.549——估計噪音有害。RP 偏離>5% 在 51% 天，但偏離時兩方向都 hurt（over-SPY -0.24%/yr, over-GLD -0.69%/yr）。Inverse variance 更差（更多噪音）。DeMiguel 1/N rule 確認。結論：50/50 SPY/GLD 恰好是 RP optimal，不需要估計。

title: K709: Rate-Conditional Allocation — Delta only +0.019 Sharpe, not actionable
content: [提出: K663/K706 延伸, 執行: Claude] 利率條件 60/40↔40/60 SPY/GLD（rising→more SPY, falling→more GLD）。Falling regime GLD +30.8% vs SPY +13.4%（huge gap）但 lag 6m window 後 conditional Sharpe 0.869 vs BH 0.850 Δ=+0.019——太小不值得。Rate regime 佔比：rising 21%, stable 62%, falling 19%。結論：利率資訊到達太晚（6m lag），且配置差異只有 ±10pp，效果微小。

title: K710: Volume as Vol Predictor — Incremental R² only 0.0023 beyond VIX
content: [提出: 新信號探索, 執行: Claude] SPY volume z-score(22d) 預測 next-day RV。Volume-RV corr=0.116 vs VIX 0.429。R² VIX only=0.184，VIX+Volume=0.186（增量 0.0023）。Volume 幾乎沒有 VIX 之外的預測力。VIX sufficiency 再再確認。

title: K711: Term Structure Slope — Does NOT predict direction (corr -0.01), contango-only worse
content: [提出: K638 方向角度, 執行: Claude] VIX3M/VIX slope lag-1 vs next-day SPY return corr=-0.010。Quintile 無單調（Q3 +31.2% Q4 +1.2%——random）。Contango-only Sharpe 0.589 < BH 0.601（-0.011）。結論：term structure 不預測方向（K638 已知不預測 vol beyond VIX，現確認也不預測 direction）。VIX sufficiency 又一次確認。

title: K712: ETF Robustness — 50/50 holds with VTI/IAU (corr>0.99 with SPY/GLD)

title: K713: ★★ Adding 25% TLT improves Sharpe 0.860→0.933 and MDD -37→-24%
content: [提出: K702 延伸, 執行: Claude] 50/50 SPY/GLD 加入 TLT 0-30%。Sharpe 單調增到 25%TLT(0.933)然後微降。MDD 單調改善(-36.8→-23.8%)。Calmar 在 25%TLT 最佳(0.41 vs 0%TLT 0.31)。37.5/37.5/25 SPY/GLD/TLT 可能是更好的 3-asset 靜態配置。但：TLT CAGR 低(2.89%)且 2022 升息大虧——需 cross-OOS 確認 TLT 不是 period-specific。CAGR 從 11.4%→9.7%（犧牲 1.7%/yr 換 Sharpe +0.073 和 MDD +13pp）。

title: K715: ★★★ Same-Period Truth — VT strategies DO beat BH in 2023-2026 (high VIX period)
content: [提出: 同期間驗證, 執行: Claude] evaluate_new_strategy 同期間比較。BH 50/50 Sharpe 1.862 排 #11/15——已上架 top 10 全部勝過 BH！recommended_5050(12/VIX) 1.865 微幅勝。這與 K687(20yr BH best)看似矛盾——但不矛盾：2023-2026 是高 VIX 期間（tariff shock），VT 在此環境特別有效。20 年長期 VT 不產生 alpha，但 3 年 live 期間 VT 表現優秀。結論：VT 的價值是 regime-dependent——高 VIX 環境中 VT 真正優越。現有策略的 paper_trading 績效是真實的（forward tracking），不需要懷疑。

title: K716: ★★★ Panic Paralysis CONFIRMED — normalized shock impact decreases with VIX
content: [提出: 用戶, 執行: Claude] 恐慌麻痺效應驗證。VIX shock(|ΔVIX|>2) 的 |SPY return| 隨 VIX 增加（raw amplification），但 normalized(|r|/VIX) 隨 VIX 遞減（slope=-0.00028）——每單位恐慌的邊際衝擊遞減。Shock/normal ratio: calm 3.16x → elevated 2.37x → high 2.32x。VIX=12 時 2pt shock = 17% 相對變化（大驚小怪），VIX=35 時 2pt = 6%（已經麻了）。可發展為論文：「波動率吸收假說——恐慌的邊際遞減」。與 K661(NFP VIX>25 效果消失) 一致。

title: K717: ★★★ Multi-Dimensional Evaluation — Taiwan Momentum #1 composite, Piecewise drops to #3
content: [提出: 用戶, 執行: Claude] 6 維度 composite（CAGR + Sharpe + MDD + Calmar + 月勝率 + 壓力表現，等權重）。排名洗牌：TW Momentum composite #1（CAGR 32.6% + stress +6.6%），Adaptive #2，Piecewise #3（CAGR 14.3% 拖累）。VIX Cond Leverage 月勝率 87.2%（最高）。50/50 降到 #11（CAGR 13.7%）。結論：純 Sharpe 排名偏向低 vol 低 return 策略，composite 更反映「好策略」的完整面貌。

title: K718: ★★ Panic Paralysis Cross-Asset — 3/4 assets confirm (SPY strongest, 0050 exception)
content: [提出: K716 延伸, 執行: Claude] SPY/GLD/TLT/0050 跨資產驗證。Normalized slope: SPY -0.00028, GLD -0.00043, TLT -0.00044, 0050 +0.00019。3/4 確認麻痺。SPY ratio 從 calm 3.16x 降到 high 2.63x（最明顯）。0050 不顯著（可能因 VIX lag）。GLD/TLT ratio 看似上升但 normalized 是負的——相對於 VIX 水平衝擊遞減。結論：恐慌麻痺是美國市場的普遍現象，可能因為 VIX 本身就是美國市場指標。

title: K719: ⚠️ VRP sign flip PARTIALLY WRONG — VRP narrows but stays positive with rolling RV22
content: [提出: 用戶要求經濟意涵, 執行: Claude] 5 大 implications: (1)Options: VIX>25 VRP=-3.1%（選擇權被低估！）vs VIX<15 VRP=+4.6%。(2)Hedging: 高 VIX 避險 payoff ratio 13.7x→3.6x（性價比大降）。(3)Rebalance: 所有 regime value≈0。(4)Crisis: VIX>30 fwd 5d=-1.55% 20d=-6.16%（危機初期不是買點）。(5)Strategy: 12/VIX 自然處理麻痺（exposure∝1/VIX），K649 額外 overlay 有害。論文框架：Paralysis → VRP sign flip → hedging cost-benefit → strategy design → crisis timing。 ⚠️ K720 修正：用 rolling 22d RV 計算 VRP 在所有 quintile 都是正的（Q5 +2.8%），只是收窄不是翻負。K719 用 cross-sectional RV 導致偏差。

title: K720: ★★ VRP Correction — narrows at high VIX (+2.8%) but stays POSITIVE, not tradeable
content: [提出: K719 驗證, 執行: Claude] VRP = VIX - rolling 22d RV。Q1(VIX 11.9) VRP=+3.5%, Q5(VIX 32.7) VRP=+2.8%——收窄但不翻負。所有 sub-period VIX>25 VRP 都正。VRP 作為交易信號 corr=0.028 不能預測方向。VRP<0 fwd 20d +1.02%(t=4.90) vs VRP>0 +0.94%(t=14.28)——差異微小。修正 K719 的過度宣稱。結論：恐慌麻痺在 impact ratio 成立（K716/K718），但 VRP sign flip 不成立。論文只用 impact ratio 不用 VRP。

title: K721: ★★★ Shock Type Paralysis — Rate shocks absorbed most, geopolitical NOT absorbed
content: [提出: K716 深化, 執行: Claude] 依衝擊類型分析麻痺。Risk-off(SPY↓TLT↑ 44%)麻痺 YES absorption=+0.007。Rate shock(SPY↓TLT↓ 19%)麻痺 YES absorption=+0.019（最強）。Geopolitical(SPY↓GLD↑ 35%)麻痺 NO absorption=-0.003。機制：利率衝擊是市場已定價的風險（VIX 已反映）→被吸收。地緣政治是外生衝擊（不在 VIX 定價範圍）→不被吸收。論文意涵：VT 策略對利率衝擊自動免疫（麻痺），但對地緣政治衝擊仍然脆弱。

title: K722: Absorption-adjusted VIX does NOT improve vol prediction (corr 0.669 < raw 0.680)
content: [提出: 論文應用, 執行: Claude] 嘗試用 absorption factor 調整 VIX 來改善 vol 預測。Adjusted VIX corr=0.669 < raw VIX 0.680。Combined R² incremental 僅 0.002。結論：absorption 是描述性現象非預測工具——VIX 本身已最佳，調整反而加噪音。這強化論文定位：absorption 解釋市場行為但不改善預測。

title: K723: Codex Review Paper 4 — 3 major issues (sign convention, data mismatch, NFP overstatement)
content: [提出: Codex 審查, 執行: Codex] Paper 4 Volatility Absorption 審查。(1)Absorption sign convention 反：正值應=更大衝擊但論文解讀為更吸收。(2)SAR 數字跟 K716 不匹配——K716 有 5 bin 不是 3，且不嚴格單調。(3)NFP 過度宣稱——K661 VIX<15 p=0.069, K528 p=0.128，不能說 fully consistent。(4)NSI 方法論：VIX 同時在分母和 regressor → 機械性相關。需要：fix sign convention, regenerate tables from experiments, rewrite NFP/limitations cautiously.

title: K724: TSMC Revenue Window — 0050 vol only 1.09x normal, but 1.24x when VIX>25
content: [提出: 04/10 事件準備, 執行: Claude] TSMC 營收公告窗口(day 8-12)對 0050 vol 影響。Overall 1.09x（微小）。VIX<15 時 1.08x，VIX 15-25 1.04x，VIX>25 1.24x。恐慌麻痺效應反向：高 VIX 時 TSMC 事件效果反而更大（地緣政治/公司事件 = 外生衝擊，不被 VIX 吸收——與 K721 一致）。Current VIX=31.0 → 04/10 需注意。

title: K725: ★★ Crisis Advantage — TW Momentum best (+1.44), GARCH VT worst (-6.66)
content: [提出: 策略 crisis 表現, 執行: Claude] VIX≥25 vs <25 策略 Sharpe 比較。所有策略 crisis 時下降但幅度差異巨大。Best crisis: TW Momentum +1.44（台股 VIX lag 優勢）, TW+JP TZ +1.21, Piecewise 0.00（全現金）。Worst: GARCH VT -6.66, 12/VIX -6.07, Fear DCA -3.72。Smooth-weight 策略在 crisis 最脆弱（持有太多曝險）。台灣策略反而 crisis 最好——可能因 US VIX 的 overnight lag 讓台股有「提前反應」時間。與 K717 composite 一致：TW Momentum composite #1。

title: K726: ⚠️ CORRECTED — Taiwan crisis advantage is asset behavior, NOT VIX lag
content: [提出: K725 驗證, 執行: Claude] 用 2010-2026 長期數據驗證。VIX>25 時 Taiwan VT(8.63/VIX_lag) -11.8%/yr vs SPY VT(12/VIX_same) -20.7%/yr → 台灣少虧 9%/yr。Raw crisis: TW Sharpe -1.06 vs SPY -1.86。機制：台股開盤前已知美股收盤 VIX → 來得及在開盤時減倉。SPY 同時面對 VIX 飆升+價格暴跌。這是 timezone lag 帶來的結構性優勢——台灣 VT 策略在 crisis 時自動有「隔夜信號」保護。可寫入 Taiwan VT 論文。

title: K727: ★★ VIX Lag is Always WORSE — K726 advantage was cross-asset confound
content: [提出: K726 驗證, 執行: Claude] 跨 6 市場（TW/JP/KR/CN/Intl/US）測試 lag vs same-day VT 在 VIX>25。所有市場 lag 都更差（-3.6% to -19.2%）。K726 的 '+9%/yr advantage' 是因為比較不同資產（0050 vs SPY），0050 crisis 跌幅本來就比 SPY 小。Same-asset lag 永遠劣於 same-day（用舊信號不如用新信號）。Taiwan VT crisis 表現好是因為 0050 波動特性，不是 timezone 優勢。Self-correction: K726 結論撤回。

title: Cross-Asset Volatility Momentum: Granger Evidence but No Strategy Value
content: [提出: Codex, 執行: Claude] Cross-asset vol momentum (TLT/USO/UUP/GLD + HYG-LQD credit spread, 2010-2026, 4053 obs). GRANGER CAUSALITY: ALL 6/6 predictors Granger-cause VIX changes at 5% (bonds lag=7 p=0.006, oil lag=5 p<0.001, FX lag=2 p=0.006, gold lag=2 p=0.007, credit 5d lag=4 p<0.001, credit 20d lag=6 p<0.001). But CROSS-CORRELATIONS are tiny: max |r|=0.087 (credit_change5 at 5d horizon). VOL PREDICTION: Composite adds NEGATIVE OOS R2 (-0.022), DM t=-1.45 (Harvey FAIL). STRATEGY (5 OOS periods): Wins 2/5 vs 50/50 (avg Sharpe diff -0.060), 2/5 vs 12/VIX (avg -0.068). Only COVID period helped (+0.34 Sharpe vs 50/50) where cross-asset stress correctly signaled defensive positioning. CONCLUSION: Statistical Granger causality exists (vol shocks in bonds/oil/FX/credit DO lead VIX) but effect sizes are too small for profitable timing. VIX already embeds cross-asset information efficiently. Upgrades from K537: FRED credit (fell back to HYG-LQD), USO added, formal Granger with AIC lag, vol momentum not just levels, TX costs, signal.shift(1), 5 OOS periods. Both K537 and K730 confirm VIX sufficiency.

title: VIX Term Structure Trading Strategy — Null Result
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K731: VIX term structure (VIX/VIX3M ratio) does NOT improve smooth-weight trading strategies. Full sample (2008-2026, N=4566): 12/VIX Sharpe 0.870, best TS variant (Contango Boost) Sharpe 0.880 — improvement of only +0.010, not meaningful. Information content: VIX/VIX3M ratio has incremental R² of +0.033 beyond VIX level for predicting 22d forward vol (F=309, p≈0), but this in-sample statistical significance does NOT translate to strategy improvement. Double sort (controlling VIX level): ratio spread avg +0.045%/5d, t=0.65, p=0.55 — no independent effect. Cross-OOS: all TS variants beat BH 50/50 in 5/5 periods, but so does plain 12/VIX (4/5). Recent OOS (2022-2026): BH 50/50 Sharpe 1.20 dominates all VT variants (~0.94). LAG ROBUSTNESS: lag-0 to lag-1 decay +0.757 — NOT lag-robust (unlike pure 12/VIX). This is because VIX/VIX3M ratio changes abruptly during vol events, creating large same-day effects. Sensitivity: backwardation threshold 0.95-1.10 changes Sharpe by only ±0.01. Confirms: VIX level is sufficient for smooth-weight VT. Term structure info is absorbed by VIX level. Backwardation signal adds complexity without benefit in smooth-weight context.
evidence: Full sample N=4566. 12/VIX SR 0.870 vs best TS 0.880 (Δ+0.010). DM vs 12/VIX: all fail Harvey t>3. Lag decay +0.757. Double-sort t=0.65 p=0.55.

title: Codex Review K730: 5 bugs found but NULL conclusion stands
content: [提出: Codex, 執行: Claude] Codex review of K730 found 5 issues: (1) HIGH: Granger test uses min-p lag picking (p-hacking), not AIC as claimed — significance overstated. (2) HIGH: TX costs charge only 1 leg (abs(Δw_spy)), should be 2 legs (abs(Δw_spy)+abs(Δw_gld)=2×abs(Δw_spy)) — costs understated by ~50%. (3) MEDIUM: signal.shift(1) applied after OOS slicing — boundary state resets. (4) MEDIUM: 50/50 baseline is constant-mix (daily rebalance) not buy-and-hold as K702. (5) MEDIUM: Log returns weighted linearly then compounded with (1+r) — mathematically inconsistent. NULL conclusion SAFE: all bugs would make strategy performance WORSE (higher costs, stricter Granger, correct baseline). VIX sufficiency still confirmed.

title: K732: Behavioral Sentiment Index (BSI) for Vol Prediction — Null, VIX Sufficiency #35
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K732: Composite Behavioral Sentiment Index (BSI) combining SKEW + VIX/VIX3M ratio + VIX momentum + VIX level (equal-weight percentile ranks, 252d window). N=3760, 2011-2026. CBOE Put/Call ratio (^CPCE) unavailable via yfinance; used behavioral proxies. Part A: BSI-RV5d corr=0.347 (sig) but partial_r|VIX=0.091 (tiny). Regression Δ R²=0.004 (VIX R²=0.478 → VIX+BSI 0.482). OOS DM t=1.64 (Harvey FAIL). Part B: BSI Fear Hedge Sharpe=0.900 < BH 50/50 0.947 < 12/VIX 0.950. DM vs BH t=-1.18 (NS). TX cost 0.51%/yr. Part C: Cross-OOS 2/5 FAIL. Part D: VIX level pctile (r=0.473) and VIX term structure (r=0.414) dominate; SKEW pctile r=-0.236 (wrong sign for fear). Regime analysis: Fear RV=20.9% vs Greed=9.2% (t=13.92, sig) but this is entirely captured by VIX level. Conclusion: composite behavioral proxies do not add to VIX for either prediction or trading. VIX sufficiency #35.

title: Codex Review K731: TX cost 1-leg bug (same as K730), OOS benchmark switch
content: [提出: Codex, 執行: Claude] Codex K731 review: (1) HIGH: TX costs charge only 1 leg — recurring pattern from K730. Both-leg convention is standard per K704. (2) MEDIUM: OOS benchmark switches from 12/VIX (Part 2) to BH 50/50 (Part 3). (3) MEDIUM: DM test uses squared returns not return difference. (4) LOW: OOS min 252d not enforced (uses 100d threshold). Positives: signal.shift(1) correct, no lookahead, simple returns consistent. NULL conclusion SAFE. PATTERN: TX cost 1-leg bug appeared in K730 AND K731 — future experiment templates must use sum(abs(Δw)) across ALL assets.

[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K733: Regime-Dependent Rebalancing Frequency — NULL RESULT confirmed. Adaptive rebalancing (daily in high-vol, monthly in low-vol) does NOT improve over fixed monthly. 12/VIX SPY/GLD results (2006-2026, 5029 days, 5 bps TX): Fixed Monthly Sharpe 0.8917 (BEST), Daily 0.8180, Weekly 0.8510, Quarterly 0.7724, Adaptive v1 (D>25/W>15/M≤15) 0.8318, Adaptive v2 (D>30/M) 0.8358. Key findings: (1) Monthly best net Sharpe because TX drag is minimal (13 bps/yr vs Daily 86 bps/yr). (2) Gross Sharpe nearly identical (0.885-0.901) across all except Quarterly (0.777) — the difference is mostly TX. (3) DM test: Daily/Weekly/Quarterly/Adaptive v1 all statistically DIFFERENT from Monthly (p<0.001), but WORSE. (4) Cross-OOS: Monthly wins 3-4/5 periods. Adaptive v1 wins only 1/5. (5) Regime-conditional: In high-vol (VIX>25), Daily Sharpe -1.17 vs Monthly -1.16 — negligible difference. In low-vol, all VT strategies similar (~4.2 Sharpe). (6) BH 50/50 Sharpe 0.8084 — VT beats BH mainly via low-vol periods. Conclusion: Monthly rebalancing is optimal regardless of VIX regime. 12/VIX weight is already smooth enough that daily adjustment adds only TX cost without improving timing.

title: Regime-Dependent Rebalancing: Monthly wins regardless of VIX regime
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K733 tested adaptive rebalancing (daily in high-vol, monthly in low-vol) vs fixed frequencies. Data: SPY+GLD+VIX, 2006-2026, 5029 days. Monthly Net Sharpe 0.892 > Weekly 0.851 > Adaptive v2 0.836 > Adaptive v1 0.832 > Daily 0.818. Monthly TX drag only 13 bps/yr vs Daily 86 bps. DM tests: Daily/Weekly/Quarterly/Adaptive all significantly worse than Monthly (p<0.001). Cross-OOS: Monthly wins 3-4/5 periods. In high-vol (VIX>25), daily Sharpe -1.17 ≈ monthly -1.16 — no benefit from faster rebalancing in crises. Conclusion: 12/VIX is inherently smooth, monthly rebalancing is robust regardless of regime.

title: K734: VRP Trading Signal — Comprehensive test confirms VRP NOT tradeable beyond 12/VIX
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] VRP = VIX - 22d Realized Vol. Part A: VRP mean=+3.50%, 85% positive, highly autocorrelated (lag1=0.93). By regime: Low VIX VRP=+3.2%, High VIX VRP=+4.4%, Extreme VIX VRP=+0.3% (narrows). Part B: VRP predicts returns at 1d (t=3.51), 5d (t=2.79), 22d (t=2.23) but R²<0.3%. Partial corr controlling VIX = 0.054 (p=0.0001) — statistically significant but economically trivial. VRP Q5 fwd 22d ann=22.7% vs Q1=14.0% — monotonic but small. VRP<0 contrarian analysis: NOT significant (t=-1.41, p=0.16), contradicts K539 magnitude. Part C: 3 VRP strategies (Timing/Percentile/Momentum) all Sharpe 0.74-0.80 vs 12/VIX 0.81 — ALL worse. DM test all p>0.83 (massively insignificant). Cross-OOS: 1-2/5 wins vs BH. VRP strategies have 30-70% MORE turnover than 12/VIX → higher TX drag. Key insight: R²(VRP~VIX)=3.3% — VRP is 97% orthogonal to VIX, but the orthogonal part has zero trading value. Confirms K430/K440/K539/K720. 數據來源: yfinance SPY/GLD/VIX 2006-2026.

[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K735 Drawdown Recovery Speed Prediction. SPY 2006-2026, 22 drawdown episodes (>5% depth). VIX at drawdown onset is a significant predictor of DEPTH (Spearman rho=-0.489, p=0.021, 95% CI [-0.73,-0.09]) and RECOVERY TIME (rho=+0.448, p=0.037, CI [+0.04,+0.74]), but NOT days-to-trough (rho=-0.05, NS). VIX CHANGE during drawdown is even stronger (rho with depth=-0.711, rho with recovery=+0.604). VIX regime strategy (reduce to 50% when predicted recovery >120 days) beats BH in 5/5 OOS periods: Sharpe 0.687 vs 0.534, MDD -34.8% vs -55.2%. However R-squared is low (0.041-0.086) — wide uncertainty per episode. Log-log elasticity: 1% higher VIX -> 1.92% longer recovery. Key insight: VIX is a NEW utility — drawdown DURATION predictor, not just vol predictor. Exclud GFC: rho with depth still -0.437 (p=0.048). Limitation: only 22 episodes in 20 years.

title: K736: ★★★★ Calendar Anomalies & VT — VT Alpha is NOT 'Sell in May' (R²=0.0000, only 1.2% seasonal)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K736 tests whether 12/VIX strategy alpha is just the 'Sell in May' calendar anomaly. DEFINITIVE ANSWER: NO. (1) VIX seasonal pattern is REVERSED — VIX is slightly HIGHER in winter (19.8) than summer (19.2), t=-2.39, p=0.017. 12/VIX naturally gives MORE equity in summer, OPPOSITE of Sell-in-May. (2) Calendar-only strategy (100% SPY winter, 50/50 summer) Sharpe=0.658 vs 12/VIX Sharpe=0.806 vs BH Sharpe=0.862. Calendar beats BH in only 1/5 OOS periods. (3) Regression: calendar explains R²=0.0000 of VT excess return; TSMOM explains R²=0.118. Calendar beta t=-0.15 (completely insignificant). (4) Only 1.2% of VT weight variation is seasonal (R² month dummies); 98.8% is VIX-level driven. Partial corr(VT weight, VIX | month) = -0.867. (5) VT-exCalendar (de-seasonalized VIX) performs nearly identically to standard 12/VIX (corr=0.998). VERDICT: VT responds to VIX LEVEL (fear/uncertainty), not season. This refutes the calendar anomaly explanation. Combined with K46/K53 (TSMOM r=0.564): VT alpha = trend following + vol-level response, NOT calendar artifact. Data: SPY/GLD/VIX 2006-2026, 5089 days, TX=5bps, signal.shift(1).

[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K737 Maximum Diversification Portfolio: tested 4 methods (EW, MinVar, MaxDiv, RiskParity) × 7 asset subsets (2-9 assets) vs 50/50 SPY/GLD baseline. COMMON_START 2023-01-04 to 2026-03-27. Key findings: (1) NO multi-asset strategy beats 50/50 SPY/GLD on Sharpe (baseline 1.862). Adding assets dilutes returns without improving risk-adjusted performance. (2) More assets → lower MDD but lower Sharpe: 9-asset EW MDD=-8.33% (vs -12.89%) but Sharpe=1.285. MinVar 9-asset MDD=-5.72% but Sharpe=1.007. (3) TLT hurts in 2023-2026: 3-asset with TLT Sharpe=1.49-1.51 vs without TLT 1.67-1.80. (4) 1/N beats optimization at same asset count (DeMiguel et al 2009 confirmed). (5) Max Diversification allocates heavily to low-vol bonds (IEF 68%) — DR=1.85 but low return. (6) Cross-OOS: only max_div 9-asset passes 3/5, but its COMMON Sharpe is only 0.87. (7) Sensitivity: longer lookback (504) helps max_div (1.37 vs 0.87) but still far below 50/50. CONCLUSION: asset selection cannot beat 50/50 SPY/GLD in 2023-2026 — the GLD bull run (+61% in 2025) makes any dilution harmful. The diversification-return tradeoff is unfavorable: you buy lower MDD but pay too much in Sharpe.

title: K738: ★★★★ VT Insurance Cost-Benefit Analysis — Cross-Asset Quantification
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K738 (v2, Codex bug-fix): Comprehensive VT cost-benefit across 5 assets (SPY/GLD/QQQ/EEM/0050.TW), 2007-2026. Fixed 4 bugs from Codex review: (a) MDD reduction sign inversion, (b) cash carry omitted in VT returns (now uses RF_DAILY per K687), (c) break-even gamma coarse grid → fine grid 1-30 with interpolation + monotonicity check, (d) total cost double-counted TX. CORRECTED FINDINGS: (1) 12/VIX costs +3.49%/yr return drag (avg), EWMA VT costs +2.12%/yr. (2) Cost per 1pp MDD reduction: 12/VIX=0.321%/yr, EWMA=0.310%/yr — nearly identical cost-efficiency. (3) Break-even gamma (interpolated): 12/VIX median=4.5, EWMA median=4.4 — investors with gamma>=4.4 benefit from VT. (4) 50/50 diversification: -0.51%/yr drag (negative drag = free return!) with large MDD reduction — cheapest insurance. (5) SPY: EWMA VT cost 0.095%/yr per pp MDD reduction (most efficient). (6) 0050.TW: 12/VIX Sharpe=0.793 vs BH 50/50=0.638. (7) MDD reductions now correctly positive: 12/VIX avg +12.3pp, EWMA avg +9.6pp across assets. Decision guide unchanged: gamma<2 → BH 100%; gamma 2-5 → BH 50/50; gamma 5-10 → 12/VIX VT; gamma>10 → EWMA VT.

title: What Makes a Good Trading Strategy? Meta-Analysis of 14 Paper-Trading Strategies
content: [提出: 用戶, 執行: Claude] 14 策略 meta-analysis（2023-01-04~2026-03-27 實際 paper trading）。核心發現：(1) 複雜度不預測 Sharpe（Spearman rho=0.149, p=0.611），簡單 VIX 策略表現與 GARCH 同級。(2) 多資產分散溢酬 +0.826 Sharpe，SPY+GLD 均值 2.546 vs SPY-only 1.176。(3) Piecewise Conservative 獨佔效率前緣（Sharpe 3.158, MDD -2.48%, Calmar 7.26）。(4) 月頻再平衡略勝日頻（2.343 vs 2.094），可能因交易成本節省。(5) 投資人分類指南：保守→Piecewise/Adaptive Tier，成長→台股動量/TW+JP TZ，台灣→台股混合槓桿/台灣 VT，簡單→12/VIX/50-50。14 策略 Sharpe 中位數 2.17，MDD 中位數 -9.2%。局限：3.2 年追蹤期、多頭市場偏差、不含 2020 崩盤。

title: K741: ★★ NFP Event Vol Study — 5-Part Comprehensive Analysis for 04/03
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] 195 NFP events (2010-2026), 7 assets. Part A: NFP |r|=0.816% vs normal 0.713% (1.14x, Wilcoxon p=0.004). 59.5% positive (p=0.010). VIX drops 68.7% of NFP days (uncertainty resolution). Part B: VIX regime is KEY — Low VIX NFP +23% vol (p=0.05), Med +18% (p=0.08), Elevated +17% (ns), High VIX NFP effect VANISHES (ratio 0.98x, p=0.93). VIX 22-27 (current): expect |move| 1.16%, 66.7% positive. Part C: Sector dispersion NOT higher on NFP (0.99x, p=0.79) — surprise null result. XLF most sensitive (1.14x, p=0.08), XLV least (1.04x). Part D: Avoiding NFP costs returns — BH Sharpe 0.816 vs Skip 0.720; NFP contributes 7.4% of total return despite only 4.8% of trading days. Part E: T-2 pre-NFP drift +0.20% (p=0.009), 5-day post-NFP drift +0.36% (p=0.029). April 3 guidance: VIX~24 → muted impact, HOLD position. 數據來源: yfinance SPY/XLF/XLK/XLE/XLV/XLI/VIX 2010-2026。

title: K742: ★★ 12/VIX Crowding Risk Simulation — safe to publish, feedback loops always converge
content: [提出: Claude 面向G, 執行: Claude] K742: SIMULATION (theoretical). Dollar-denominated crowding analysis of 12/VIX strategy using Kyle's lambda + VIX-SPY elasticity feedback loops. Data: SPY/VIX 2006-2026 (5087 days). KEY FINDINGS: (1) 12/VIX is inherently crowding-resistant — smooth 1/VIX concave mapping with mean daily |Δw|=0.035, annual turnover 8.9x (much lower than binary signals). (2) Feedback loops ALWAYS converge (tested λ≤0.50, AUM≤$500B) — geometric decay, NOT positive feedback like 1987 portfolio insurance. (3) Worst-day extra impact thresholds (λ=moderate): 5 bps at $0.3B, 25 bps at $1.5B, 50 bps at $2.9B, 100 bps at $5.6B AUM. (4) Sharpe degradation: $0.1B→-6%, $1B→-60%. Friction grows linearly with AUM. (5) Retail adoption (<$1B) has NEGLIGIBLE crowding risk. Even $10B institutional scale, while producing measurable friction, does not destabilize. (6) Publishing 12/VIX is safe for responsible disclosure — global VT AUM ~$50-200B across ALL variants, 12/VIX specifically would capture tiny fraction. (7) Key protection vs 1987 crash: discrete daily rebalancing (not continuous), concave mapping (not linear), heterogeneous timing in practice. LIMITATIONS: Kyle lambda approximate (0.01-0.50 range), constant VIX elasticity (-4x), assumes simultaneous rebalancing (worst case), no arbitrageur response modeled. Extends K94/K110 (abstract adoption rates) with dollar-denominated AUM analysis. Script: experiments/k742_crowding_simulation.py. Data: yfinance SPY/VIX 2006-2026.

title: Codex Review K742: 2 HIGH (lag misalign + Sharpe formula), crowding-resistant conclusion directionally safe
content: [提出: Codex, 執行: Claude] K742 review: (1) HIGH: Part B lag-misaligned — VIX spike ranked by VIX[t] but weight_change uses VIX[t-1]/VIX[t-2]. Explains zero-flow on large spikes. (2) HIGH: Part D Sharpe-drag scales with held weight, should scale with |Δw| (traded fraction). Overstates drag. (3) MEDIUM: Kyle lambda 0.50 not justified for SPY (0.10 defensible). (4) MEDIUM: VIX elasticity -4.0 unsourced. (5) LOW: 'geometric decay' too strong — convergence is from bounded 12/VIX target, not local contraction. DIRECTION SAFE: 1/x concavity IS self-dampening, convergence IS proven. Specific AUM thresholds need fix.

[提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K743 Investor Behavior Under VT — 5 behavioral mistakes simulated on real 12/VIX (SPY/GLD/VIX, 2007-2026, 4839 days). RANKING: (1) FOMO Override most costly (Sharpe -0.294, -58%, terminal -52%, t=3.50 ***Harvey-significant). Going 100% equity after SPY>2% days devastates returns. (2) Anchoring 2nd (Sharpe -0.111, -22%, terminal -19%). Stale 21-day VIX loses responsiveness. (3) Panic Override 3rd (Sharpe -0.071, -14%, terminal -12%). Ironically helps during GFC (+9.8% vs -7.4%) but hurts long-run. NOT stat significant. (4) Loss Aversion 4th (Sharpe -0.055, -11%, terminal -11%). Quitting VT after 3 losing months is mild. (5) SURPRISE: Delayed Rebalance HELPS (+0.092 Sharpe, +18%, terminal +26%, t=-4.59 ***). Lazy >10% threshold rebalancing beats daily — overly frequent rebalancing is a drag. Robust VT: Combined Floor(30%)/Cap(90%)+Smoothing(α=0.3)+Weekly recovers 172% of panic cost (Sharpe 0.572 vs 0.505 perfect). KEY INSIGHT: FOMO, not panic, is the deadliest behavioral mistake. Teaching investors "don't chase rallies" has 5x more value than "don't panic sell". Lazy investors do BETTER than disciplined daily rebalancers.
