title: K1083: ★★★ Currency Wrapper Explains 83% of Taiwan→EWT Gap — Paper 9 Final Mechanism Decomposition
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1083 constructs synthetic USD return for 0050.TW (r_USD_synth = r_TWD - r_TWDUSD_FX) to isolate PURE currency effect from composition/diversification. n_oos=4,848 same as K1077. CORE DECOMPOSITION: K1077 0050-TWD DM t=-0.49 (baseline, replicated -0.488). K1083 0050-USD-synth DM t=+1.79 (currency alone gains +2.28 t-units!). K1082 EWT DM t=+2.26 (+0.47 from MSCI Taiwan ADR composition). Currency 2.28 / (2.28+0.47) = 83% of Taiwan-to-EWT gap. FULL PAPER 9 MECHANISM PROGRESSION: 0050-TWD -0.49 → +currency +2.28 → 0050-USD +1.79 → +composition +0.47 → EWT +2.26 → +diversification +2.99 → EEM +5.25 → +US-native +2.67 → SPY +7.92. θ₁ STABILITY: TWD mean 1.27e-5 (127x SPY) vs USD-synth mean 2.61e-7 (2.6x SPY) — USD wrapper brings θ₁ INTO SPY-CONSISTENT REGIME. VERDICTS: H1 PASS (gap only -0.47), H2 LARGE (2.28 ≈ predicted 2.75), H3 FAIL Harvey (t=1.79, TSMC concentration 2nd barrier), H4 PASS (composition ~0). PAPER 9 FINAL CLAIM: A4f requires USD-denominated exposure as a necessary condition (explains 83% of Taiwan gap). TSMC concentration (40-50%) is residual constraint preventing full Harvey pass. VIX transmits systemic USD-funding risk primarily through the currency channel, with diversification and composition as secondary effects. CAVEAT: 2 Yahoo TWDUSD corrupted closes repaired (2011-10-25 and 2014-12-31).

title: K1084: Higher-Order Moments NULL — Semi-Variance (K1063) Spec Sufficient, RSk/RKt Add No Incremental Value
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1084 tests Realized Skewness (RSk = Σr³/RV^1.5) and Realized Kurtosis (RKt = Σr⁴/RV²) for volatility prediction. 60-day SPY 5-min, OOS n=30 PRELIMINARY. ALL NULL: H1 (RSk) DM t=-1.78 p=0.086 NULL (below Harvey). H2 (RKt predicts tail) all 5% VaR methods fail Kupiec (Normal/Student-t 6/30 viol, CF 5/30, p<0.02); 1% VaR pass but no CF improvement. H3 (HAR-Full) DM t=+0.53 WORSE than baseline. H4 (regime): Low-VIX favours HAR-RSk, High-VIX favours HAR-Full — not Harvey. NOTABLE: full-sample HAR-SJ has SJ coefficient t=-3.10 CONSISTENT with K1063 semi-variance finding. Collinearity dissolves when RSk/RKt added alongside SJ. RKt level t=+6.69 fat-tailed intraday CONFIRMED but kurtosis LEVEL ≠ kurtosis PREDICTABILITY. CAVEAT: 60-day/OOS 30 underpowered; revisit K1086 when 5-min backfill reaches ≥252 days. PAPER 9 IMPLICATION: Stay with HAR-semi-variance (K1063 spec). Higher-order moments do not add Harvey-significant incremental power.

title: K1085: ★★★ GLD A4f — Structure Generalizes, Regressor Must Be Asset-Matched (GVZ >> VIX for Gold)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1085 extends Paper 9 cross-asset to non-equity GLD (gold ETF). MAJOR THEORETICAL FINDING: A4f-VIX on GLD DM t=+1.83 FAIL Harvey (n=4848); A4f-GVZ (CBOE Gold VIX) DM t=+4.46 PASS Harvey (n=2645, 2013+). Head-to-head A4f-GVZ vs A4f-VIX DM t=+3.34 Harvey PASS — GVZ carries gold-specific information VIX misses. COMBO (VIX+GVZ) t=+3.98 PASS but not better than GVZ alone. CAVEAT: θ₁ CV GLD=2.11 vs SPY~0.7 (3x more unstable). REFINED PAPER 9 CLAIM: Neither 'equity-only' nor 'fully general' — the TRUTH is 'A4f structure generalizes across asset classes, but the τ driver must match asset's own risk factors. Equities load on S&P VIX; gold needs Gold VIX. Structure general, regressor asset-specific.' Consistent with Baur & McDermott (2010), Reboredo (2013). FINAL 9-ASSET TABLE: SPY +7.92, QQQ +5.99, EEM +5.25, IWM +4.80, GLD-GVZ +4.46, FXI +3.61 (all Harvey PASS). EWZ +2.33, EWT +2.26, GLD-VIX +1.83, 0050.TW -0.49 FAIL. DOWNSTREAM: K1086 TLT/MOVE, K1087 USO/OVX, K1088 meta-regression own-asset vs spillover, K1089 DCC-A4f asymmetric regressors for 50/50 portfolio VaR.

title: K1086: TLT A4f-MOVE FAIL — Asset-Matched Regressor Theory NOT Universal (Refutes K1085 generalization)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1086 tests if K1085's 'asset-matched regressor' theory (GLD needs GVZ, not VIX) extends to bonds. TLT 2011-2026 n=3759, 60 refits. RESULT: BOTH FAIL. A4f-VIX DM t=+1.43 FAIL. A4f-MOVE DM t=+1.36 FAIL. A4f-MOVE vs A4f-VIX pairwise DM t=-0.89 — MOVE MARGINALLY WORSE than VIX on TLT (contradicts theory). 2022 rising-rate regime: A4f-MOVE t=+1.55 but A4f-VIX t=+2.13 STRONGER. CRITICAL IMPLICATION: K1085 gold-GVZ result is NOT a universal asset-matched principle. Bond-return volatility driven by yield-curve level/slope dynamics, not option-implied vol. MOVE captures option-market fear but TLT r² dominated by duration-risk exposure channels VIX/MOVE squared don't efficiently capture. VIX-MOVE correlation 0.586 means MOVE's long-run signal largely redundant for TLT. PAPER 9 REFINED (AGAIN): 'A4f structure is general, but successful exogenous regressor identification is asset-class specific and not guaranteed. SPY+VIX works strongly; GLD+GVZ works moderately; TLT+MOVE fails.' K1085 gold finding may reflect particular VIX-GVZ decoupling rather than universal principle. FOLLOW-UPS: K1087 TLT with yield-curve factors (slope², level); K1088 IEF/EDV duration gradient; K1089 credit spreads for LQD/HYG; reconsider K1085 robustness.

title: K1087: ★ TLT Yield-Curve Factors ALL FAIL — Paper 9 Scope Limited to Equity+Commodity, NOT Bonds
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1087 tests 7 regressor candidates for TLT A4f: VIX, MOVE, Yield Level, Slope, Realized Rate Vol, Butterfly, Combo. n=3,756 OOS 2011-2026, 60 refits. ALL 4 HYPOTHESES FAIL. Full OOS DM t: VIX +2.02 (best but NS), MOVE +1.87, Level -1.26 NEGATIVE, Slope -1.27 NEGATIVE, RateVol +0.45 (essentially zero), Butterfly -0.82 NEGATIVE, Combo +1.70. CRITICAL METHODOLOGICAL FINDING: Corr(TLT r², |ΔY10|²)=0.652 >> Corr(TLT r², VIX²)=0.381 yet RateVol delivers only t=+0.45 in A4f framework. SINGLE-DAY CORRELATION DOES NOT TRANSLATE TO CONDITIONAL VARIANCE FORECAST SKILL. The mechanical r²↔|ΔY|² link (TLT return ≈ -duration×ΔY accounting identity) is already absorbed by GARCH recursion on returns, leaving no incremental signal. PAPER 9 FINAL SCOPE: K1086 + K1087 together establish TLT vol dynamics INCOMPATIBLE with A4f MIDAS τ×g decomposition regardless of regressor choice. Asset-matched regressor theory (K1075 SPY-VIX, K1085 GLD-GVZ) CANNOT extend to bonds. Paper 9 must LIMIT CLAIMS to equity + commodity. FOLLOW-UPS: regime-switching GARCH on TLT, duration-adjusted tau, 2-factor stochastic vol for bonds, or reconsider whether bond vol modeling needs fundamentally different structure.

title: K1088: ★★★ USO+OVX PASS (t=+4.48) — Asset-Matched Theory Confirmed on 4th Class, K1085 Not Idiosyncratic
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1088 tests A4f on USO (oil) with OVX (CBOE oil VIX). n=2,960 OOS 2010-2026. ALL HYPOTHESES PASS: H1 USO+OVX Harvey PASS DM t=+4.475 (p<1e-5). H2 OVX beats VIX head-to-head DM t=+3.18 (OVX_SUPERIOR confirmed). H3 θ₁ stability reasonable (CV OVX 2.99 vs VIX 3.98). H4 COMBO beats VIX (+3.04) but COMBO=OVX (-1.23, OVX subsumes VIX). H5 robust to 2020 negative oil (+4.42 = 98.8% of H1). OVX_Extreme bucket [60,100) shows A4f largest gain -13.46% QLIKE (n=131). PAPER 9 SCOPE FINAL: 4-asset-class matrix complete. Equity (5 ETFs VIX +3.6~+7.9) PASS, Commodity-Gold (GVZ +4.46) PASS, Commodity-Oil (OVX +4.48) PASS, Bonds (TLT: MOVE/yield FAIL K1086/K1087) FAIL. KEY THEORETICAL CONCLUSION: K1085 gold was NOT idiosyncratic. Asset-matched-IV principle generalizes across liquid USD risky asset classes. Bonds are the exception due to mechanical duration-ΔY identity absorbing incremental signal. FINAL PAPER 9 SCOPE STATEMENT: 'A4f's asset-matched implied-volatility structure (τ=θ₀+θ₁·IV²_{t-1}) extends across liquid USD-denominated equity and commodity ETFs (gold and crude oil). Bonds lie outside scope because the mechanical duration-ΔY identity absorbs the incremental signal.' FOLLOW-UPS: K1089 copper/natgas, K1090 FX, K1091 crypto.

title: K1089: BTC A4f NULL — Crypto Outside Paper 9 Scope. High-VIX Regime Shows Negative Loading (K1025 Fear Asymmetry)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1089 tests A4f on BTC-USD 2018-2026 (n=3,023) to extend asset-matched theory to crypto. ALL NULL: H1 A4f-VIX DM t=+1.13 (not Harvey). H2 A4f-BTC30RV (30d RV home-IV proxy) DM t=+0.55. H3 VIX vs BTC30RV tie (DM t=-0.47). H4 COMBO no improvement. H5 Partial directional (5/6 crypto crises positive but not Harvey). H6 STRIKING REVERSAL: High-VIX [25,40) bucket A4f-VIX DM t=-2.91 (near-sig WRONG DIRECTION) — loading VIX HURTS BTC vol prediction when equity fear elevated. Consistent with K1025 asymmetric crypto fear channel (BTC only downtrends transmit fear; during equity stress, crypto decouples or moves counter). θ₁ CV 4.05(VIX)/2.31(RV) parameters essentially unidentified. DATA LIMITATION: BVIV (Volmex) and DVOL (Deribit) NOT available on yfinance (verified 2026-04-12, 404s). Used 30-day RV as home-IV proxy. PAPER 9 FINAL SCOPE: Equity (VIX) + Commodity-Gold (GVZ) + Commodity-Oil (OVX) PASS; Bonds (TLT) + Crypto (BTC) FAIL. 4 assets PASS out of 5 classes. 'Asset-matched implied volatility' principle applies only to LIQUID USD RISKY ASSETS where VIX-style IV captures sufficient systematic information. Crypto requires true crypto-specific IV (BVIV/DVOL) for fair test, but available proxies insufficient. Bonds structurally incompatible (duration-ΔY identity). FOLLOW-UPS: K1090 ETH replication, K1091 regime-switching VIX-crypto corr, K1092 scraping actual Deribit DVOL, K1093 multi-factor crypto A4f (Fear&Greed, USDT cap, hash rate).
data_source: yfinance BTC-USD 2014-2026 + VIX + 30d RV proxy, n_oos=3023

title: K1090: ★★ A4f Cross-Asset Meta-Regression — Paper 9 Gets Predictor Formula
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1090 performs meta-regression of A4f DM t on asset characteristics for 12 assets (K1075-K1089). COMPACT OLS FORMULA: DM_t ≈ -1.22 + 3.38·USD_dummy - 4.11·corr(ret,ΔVIX), SEs 1.79/1.90/1.88, R²=0.54, LOOCV R²=0.26, LOOCV RMSE=1.94. LASSO independently selects SAME 2 features (currency_usd + corr_ret_vix). Decision tree depth 3 splits on hhi_concentration + class_commodity. KEY PREDICTORS: (1) currency_usd dummy is dominant (standardized coef +0.57 in Ridge), (2) negative correlation of return with ΔVIX is second predictor (standardized -0.52). PREDICTIONS for 6 untested assets (Ridge + bootstrap CI B=10,000): VGK (European) +4.71 strong_run; EWJ (Japan) +4.34 strong_run; CPER (Copper) +3.58 run; SLV (Silver) +3.58 run; IEF (short bonds) +1.93 likely_fail; ETH-USD +1.28 likely_fail. CAVEATS: N=12 → marginal p-values, currency_usd effectively identified from SINGLE non-USD sample (0050.TW), ±2.5 PIs means predictions are prioritization hints not promises. Ridge LOOCV under-shoots SPY/QQQ (shrinkage), over-shoots 0050.TW/BTC (feature gaps). PAPER 9 USE: This provides scope-prediction formula for new assets. Very rare empirical paper-level contribution. Readers/practitioners can estimate A4f applicability before running experiments. Natural Paper 9 Section 6 closer.
data_source: 12 A4f experiments (K1075-K1089) + yfinance features + VIX data

title: K1091: Meta Prediction Out-of-Sample Test — Equities VGK/EWJ PASS Clean, Commodities CPER/SLV FAIL (No Matched IV)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1091 validates K1090 meta-regression by running A4f on 4 predicted-PASS assets. VGK (European): predicted +4.71, realized +4.46, |err|=0.25, Harvey PASS ⭐. EWJ (Japan): predicted +4.34, realized +4.81, |err|=0.47, Harvey PASS ⭐. CPER (Copper): predicted +3.58, realized +0.44, |err|=3.14, FAIL. SLV (Silver): predicted +3.58, realized -0.08, |err|=3.67, FAIL. MAE=1.88 < K1090 LOOCV RMSE 1.94 (marginal PASS). HARVEY 2/4, DIRECTION-CORRECT 2/4. CLEAN ASSET-CLASS SPLIT: Equities (VGK+EWJ) predictions errors <0.5; Commodities without matched IV (CPER+SLV) fail completely. RE-CONFIRMS K1088 LESSON: Commodity ETFs need matched IV (GVZ for gold, OVX for oil). Generic VIX insufficient. MECHANISM: CPER ret-VIX correlation -0.054, SLV -0.041 (vs GLD -0.149). Ridge pulls commodity predictions toward equity mean because K1090 training set only had ONE matched-IV commodity pair (GLD+GVZ via K1085 and USO+OVX via K1088). PAPER 9 META FORMULA REFINEMENT: Add binary feature `has_matched_IV` — within-class currency rule works perfectly for equities, but commodities need explicit IV-matching flag. Without it, meta formula systematically over-predicts commodities lacking matched IV. CONTRIBUTION: This is the cleanest out-of-sample validation of cross-asset A4f scope prediction to date. 16-asset matrix now available (12 training + 4 validation).

title: K1092: Asymmetric DCC-A4f (SPY-VIX + GLD-GVZ) — Strictly Pareto-Dominant but Below Harvey vs Symmetric
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1092 applies asset-matched theory to portfolio VaR. Tests DCC-A4f-ASYM (SPY+VIX², GLD+GVZ²) vs DCC-A4f-SYMM (both VIX, K1041 original) vs DCC-GJR baseline. 50/50 SPY+GLD portfolio, OOS 2013-2026 n=3,234. RESULTS: DCC-A4f-ASYM vs DCC-GJR Harvey PASS on every metric: Portfolio QLIKE DM t=+5.06, FZ 1% t=+4.97, FZ 2.5% t=+3.84. But ASYM vs SYMM: QLIKE +2.95, FZ 1% +2.95, FZ 2.5% +2.14 — direction-consistent but BELOW Harvey threshold. Mean QLIKE: GJR -9.055 → SYMM -9.093 → ASYM -9.116 (best). Trinity 2.5%: all 3 PASS; ASYM highest Kupiec p (0.86). Trinity 1%: SYMM PASS, ASYM borderline FAIL CC (p=0.048 extreme clustering). H1 PARTIAL: ASYM strictly Pareto-dominant but magnitude marginal at portfolio level. MECHANISM: K1085 univariate GLD-GVZ benefit (t=4.46) attenuates in 50/50 portfolio because SPY-VIX channel dominates (SPY vol ~16% vs GLD ~15%, weights 0.5 each). PAPER 3 × PAPER 9 JOINT: Premature to claim joint paper. Need K1093 tri-variate (SPY-VIX + GLD-GVZ + TLT-MOVE) or K1094 weight sensitivity (70/30, 30/70) to push ASYM-vs-SYMM above Harvey. Commodity-heavy portfolios should amplify benefit.

title: K1093: DCC-A4f Weight Sensitivity — Monotonic Spearman +1.00, Commodity-Heavy PASS Harvey on QLIKE (Not FZ)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1093 tests K1092 attenuation hypothesis: does GLD weight increase ASYM vs SYMM benefit? 5 portfolios × 3 DCC models. OOS 2013-2026, n=3234. ALL H1-H4 CONFIRMED monotonic. QLIKE DM t by GLD%: 30%:+1.30, 40%:+2.21, 50%:+2.87 (replicates K1092 +2.95), 60%:+3.37 PASS, 70%:+3.68 PASS. Spearman ρ(DM t, weight)=+1.000 perfect monotonic. FZ 1%: 0/5 Harvey. FZ 2.5%: 1/5 Harvey (40%). MIXED PAPER 3×9 VERDICT: (1) ASYM Pareto-dominant on mean-variance forecasting (QLIKE monotonically better with GLD weight). (2) Tail risk (FZ VaR/ES) does NOT follow monotonic pattern — commodity tilting helps QLIKE but NOT tail VaR/ES significantly. (3) Sharpe trade-off: 30/70 Sharpe=0.928 vs 50/50=1.038 (commodity-heavy is worse investment). IMPLICATIONS FOR JOINT PAPER: Acknowledge that 50/50 practitioner benchmark shows only BORDERLINE ASYM benefit; commodity-heavy sees Harvey pass on QLIKE but loses Sharpe. Paper 3 (50/50 unshakable) still robust; Paper 9 (asset-matched A4f) confirmed for individual assets but attenuates in balanced portfolios. Joint paper scope: 'Asset-matched DCC-A4f strictly improves portfolio-level QLIKE monotonically with commodity weight, but optimal practitioner portfolios remain at 50/50 where ASYM benefit is below Harvey threshold.'

title: K1094: ★★ A4f-VT on 0050.TW — Paper 3 Statistical≠Strategy Confirmed Cross-Market
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1094 replicates K1074 on Taiwan 0050.TW. 5 strategies, OOS 2013-2026, net 2bp TX, 52 refits 0 failures, all lookahead guards PASS. RESULTS (Sharpe/CAGR/MDD): 8.63/VIX 1.096/9.9%/-16.3% ★, A4f-VT 1.028/17.0%/-28.8%, GJR-VT 0.745/12.3%/-39.8%, 50/50+8.63 0.909/9.0%/-21%, 50/50+A4f 1.031/12.5%/-22%, BH 0050 0.764/15.0%/-45.2%. H1 (A4f-VT LOSES) REJECTED: diff -0.065, CI [-0.18, +0.05], p=0.284 NS. H2 (mirrors K1074 pattern) CONFIRMED: Both SPY and 0050.TW show A4f statistical edge does NOT translate to strategy edge. CRITICAL INSIGHT: A4f is STATISTICALLY NULL on 0050.TW (K1077 DM t=-0.49) but STRATEGY-LEVEL matches 8.63/VIX (Sharpe diff -0.065 NS). DECOUPLING CONFIRMED CROSS-MARKET. BONUS: A4f-VT significantly beats GJR-VT on 0050.TW (+0.286, p=0.000) even though their statistical ranking is NS — external VIX² driver helps at strategy margin. PAPER 3 FINAL CLAIM STRENGTHENED: 'Statistical and strategy layers are decoupled cross-market. VT α comes from return-side (TSMOM/drawdown persistence), not vol-forecast accuracy. Investors on both SPY and 0050.TW can retain simple VT rules (12/VIX or 8.63/VIX) without statistical performance cost.' Note: A4f-VT 17% CAGR significantly higher than 8.63/VIX 9.9% but equal Sharpe reflects higher risk - investors pay for CAGR with MDD jumping -16.3% to -28.8%.

title: K1095: Event-Switched VT on 0050.TW NULL — Event Windows Cover 49-71%, Not Sparse Enough
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1095 tests synthesis strategy: 8.63/VIX normally + A4f-VT only in [-5,+5] window around top-10 stock earnings. OOS 2017-2026 (N=2,160), net 20bp TX. ALL 3 HYPOTHESES REJECTED. SHARPE: Pure 8.63/VIX 0.929, Pure A4f-VT 0.966, Event-Switched 0.777 (WORST), BH 1.020. H1 (Switched > 8.63/VIX) FAIL. H2 (Switched > A4f-VT) DM t=-2.89 p=0.004 switched STATISTICALLY WORSE. H3 (Events concentrate A4f alpha) REJECTED — every strategy has LOWER Sharpe on event days (0.46-0.65) vs non-event (1.32-1.49). WHY FAIL: (1) Event coverage 49-71% too high — top-10 stocks announce too frequently so [-5,+5] windows not sparse. (2) Event days are VOLATILITY regimes not RETURN regimes — low Sharpe everywhere. (3) Turnover doubles 13.4x vs 6.5x → 20bp TX removes ~130bp/yr. CRITICAL INSIGHT: K1062 Part D's A4f QLIKE advantage is GLOBAL not event-specific. DM t=+2.71 on A4f-VT vs 8.63/VIX spread holds regardless of event timing. K1068's CAR≈0 CASV>>0 pattern means event days show 'vol spike but no return drift' — which doesn't help VT strategy. IMPLICATION: Do NOT add event-overlay to Taiwan VT. Keep 8.63/VIX or A4f-VT pure. A4f-VT wins overall Sharpe (0.966>0.929) but 2x higher MDD (-27.9% vs -16.5%). Simple rule still best for risk-conscious investors.

title: K1096: BTC Regime-Switching A4f FAIL — Crypto Boundary Structural, Rescue Attempts Unsuccessful
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1096 tests 5 regime-switching variants to rescue K1089 BTC A4f NULL. OOS 2018-2026 n=3023. ALL FAIL: A4f-VIX full t=+1.13, Reg-VIX-OFF-HighVIX t=+0.82, Reg-VIX-ON-HighCorr t=+1.19, Adaptive |corr| t=-0.92 (WORSE than GJR). H1-H4 FAIL, no regime variant Harvey-passes. H5 PARTIAL: Two hard-switching variants DO eliminate K1089's High-VIX bucket damage (t=-0.54/-0.10 vs K1089 -2.91), but adaptive smooth weighting makes it worse (t=-3.50). CONCLUSION: BTC crypto boundary is STRUCTURAL. Regime switching can eliminate localized harm but cannot make A4f prevail overall. Indirectly confirms K1025/Paper 6 asymmetric crypto fear channel: high-VIX + high-correlation regimes are where BTC decouples most strongly, so VIX loading is most useless there. PAPER 9 FINAL: Crypto joins Bonds as structural boundary — asset-matched IV theory needs crypto-native IV (Deribit DVOL/BVIV) or HAR-RV approach instead. FOLLOW-UPS: K1097 Markov-switching HMM state-dependent GJR; K1098 Deribit DVOL if data acquirable; K1099 HAR-RV + crypto-native factors.

title: K1097: MS-GJR Student-t NULL — Regime-Label Instability Explains Failure (A4f-VIX9D-t Best Overall)
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1097 pivoted from duplicating K1019 to extending with Student-t innovations + full Trinity. Agent detected K1019 already did MS-GJR vs GJR + A4f-VIX (per CLAUDE.md 不重複原則). RESULTS: M3 MS-GJR-t QLIKE=1.630 vs M2 MS-GJR-N=1.614 → Student-t does NOT improve MS-GJR (DM t=+0.62 NS). M4 A4f-VIX9D-t remains best: QLIKE=1.568, full Trinity PASS at 1% and 5%, lowest FZ0 (-5.07). NEITHER MS variant fixes VaR: M3 Kupiec 1% p=0.04, 5% p=0.02. NOVEL EMPIRICAL FINDING: MS-GJR-t has regime-label instability across refits — mean P(calm) jumps 0.835→0.149 within 6 months. Student-t absorbing fat tails causes the 2 regimes to differentiate by persistence (one near-unit-root, one mean-reverting) rather than volatility level, breaking unconditional-variance-based ordering. PAPER 9 IMPLICATION: Strengthens case for A4f-VIX9D-t as single recommended equity model. Beats MS-GJR family even with matching Student-t. Only model passing full VaR-ES Trinity.

title: K1098: VIXTWN A4f NULL on 0050.TW — Taiwan Gap is Structural (Currency + TSMC), Paper 10 Not Supported
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1098 tests Paper 10 hypothesis: can TAIFEX VIXTWN rescue K1077 NULL on 0050.TW? Used 15 years of official Dropbox data (2007-2021), OOS 2013-2021 (~8 yrs). ALL 4 HYPOTHESES FAIL. A4f-VIXTWN DM t=+1.86 below Harvey. Head-to-head vs A4f-VIX: t=-0.99 (VIX slightly BETTER). COMBO +0.14/+1.51 no improvement. Spearman ranks with r²: VIX 0.211 > VIXTWN 0.201. REGIME TEST: even when VIXTWN-VIX spread top 20% (n=441), VIXTWN still loses DM t=-1.30. COMPLETE CROSS-ASSET MATRIX: GLD+GVZ +4.46 PASS, USO+OVX +4.48 PASS, **0050.TW+VIXTWN +1.86 FAIL**. PAPER 9 CONFIRMATION: Taiwan gap is STRUCTURAL — K1083 showed currency (USD/TWD) explains 83%, TSMC concentration is residual 17%. A domestic equity IV can't fix a currency-denomination problem. VIXTWN level-correlation with VIX=0.87 so VIXTWN adds marginal info even locally. PAPER 10 SIDE PAPER: NOT SUPPORTED by evidence. Taiwan is boundary case in Paper 9 matrix, not independent paper material. METHODOLOGY NOTE: Codex pre-review caught 2 bugs (Harvey sign for wrong-direction + VIXTWN Oct/Nov 2007 format). Fixed before run. DOWNSTREAM: K1099 USD/TWD realized vol directly; K1100 TWSE-50 ex-TSMC; K1101 single-stock TSMC with VIXTWN (isolate concentration).

title: K1099: FXVol A4f on 0050.TW NULL — Paper 10 Revival DENIED, K1083/K1099 Measure Different Decompositions
content: [提出: Claude, 執行: Claude] K1099 tests if USD/TWD realized vol (directly attacking K1083 currency channel) can be the matched τ regressor for 0050.TW. OOS 2010-2025 n=3913. ALL 4 HYPOTHESES FAIL. A4f-FX vs GJR DM t=-1.45 FAIL. H2 FX vs VIX t=+0.12 INDIFFERENT. H3 COMBO dominates t=-0.97 FAIL. H4 High-FX regime reversed: DM t=-3.50 (VIX strictly BETTER Harvey PASS wrong direction). SMOKING GUN DIAGNOSTIC: Corr(FXVol_RV21, 0050.TW realized vol)=+0.014 (essentially zero) vs Corr(VIX, 0050.TW realized vol)=+0.601 — VIX carries 42x more linear information. K1077 replication: A4f-VIX vs GJR DM t=-0.27 matches K1077's -0.49 (internal consistency check PASS). CRITICAL RESOLUTION OF APPARENT K1083/K1099 CONTRADICTION: K1083 measures FX dominates Taiwan→EWT RETURN-LEVEL gap (wrapper mechanics on return process); K1099 shows FX is IRRELEVANT to variance-level forecasting problem (variance proxy doesn't depend on FX). TWO DIFFERENT DECOMPOSITIONS — both correct. PAPER 10 IMPLICATION: Revival DENIED. Must be re-scoped away from 'FX vol is right τ regressor' toward 'EWT forecastability is superposition of equity + FX vol, not reducible to single shared τ'. K1077 + K1098 + K1099 = THREE INDEPENDENT NULL for 0050.TW from different angles → Taiwan boundary case structurally unrescuable via A4f framework.

title: K1100: Student-t/Clayton Copula-GARCH vs DCC-A4f-ASYM — Null Result on SPY/GLD
content: [提出: 用戶(copula-GARCH 專長), 執行: Claude] 測試 Student-t copula 與 Clayton copula 能否打敗 K1092 DCC-A4f-ASYM 用於 50/50 SPY+GLD portfolio VaR/ES 預測。DM 檢定：H1 (Copula-t vs DCC-A4f QLIKE) t=-1.68 NS；H2 (Clayton vs DCC-A4f QLIKE) t=-1.41 NS；FZ 1% joint: t=-0.92/-0.53 均 NS。**NULL 結果**：copula 無法顯著改善。機制：SPY-GLD 本質 tail-independent（Student-t λ=0.038，Clayton λ_L=0.007 近零；COVID 時 ρ 轉為 -0.128 反向移動，不是 crash co-movement），Clayton θ 塌至下限 0.010 無法建模負相依。Trinity: DCC-A4f-SYMM 2/2、Clayton-A4f-ASYM 2/2、Copula-t-A4f-ASYM 0/2（MC sampling noise）、DCC-A4f-ASYM 1/2（與 K1092 一致）。Mean QLIKE 最佳 DCC-A4f-ASYM (-9.11477)。含副產品：H3 Clayton vs Copula-t FZ t=+3.02 Harvey SIG、DCC-GJR vs Copula-t QLIKE t=+4.08 Harvey SIG（copula 反不如 DCC-GARCH 基準）。OOS 3234 天 (2013-06~2026-04)，MC=5000/day，seed=42。對用戶 PRS 論文 (Lai 2024 APFM) 的啟示：copula 方法對 tail-dependent pair（spot-futures）有效，對 tail-independent pair（SPY-GLD）DCC+A4f-ASYM 已足夠。

title: K1067b: UMC (2303.TW) A4f-EAV — MIXED, resolves K1067 TSMC NULL
content: [提出: 賴奕豪, 執行: Claude] 承接 K1067 TSMC NULL 的 power 驗證。UMC T+1=2.579（Top 4 最強）vs TSMC 0.983（最弱）。結果 MIXED：H1 FAIL (DM t=-1.37, Harvey NS, 方向 EAV_better)；**H2 PASS 極顯著** (θ₂ 100% 27/27 refits 為正, t=+15.43, p<1e-14)；**H3 PASS** (event T+1 DM t=-2.204, p=0.036, QLIKE 改善 +39.3%; non-event |t|=0.160)；H4 PASS (UMC +0.517% >> TSMC -0.070%)。K1067 vs K1067b 核心對比：in-sample corr 從 -0.0011 翻至 +0.0319 (29x)；θ₂ positive fraction 0.59→1.00；θ₂ one-sided p 從 0.948 翻至 6.7e-15。**結論**：既非純 H_vix 主導，也非 signal-absent。EAV 在 event window 有真預測價值但 event days 只占 1.6%，稀釋到全 OOS 未達 Harvey。**Paper 2 建議**：從 A4f 主模型 regressor list 移除 EAV，但保留為 descriptive event-window 分析（honest MIXED reporting）。**K1067 需回溯修正**：「H_vix DOMINATES」應軟化為「H_vix + power insufficient」。Codex 審查通過，方法論 100% 匹配 K1067（只改 TICKER + H4）。 **[K1103 τ-lag robustness verified 2026-04-13: bug effect negligible, conclusion HOLDS.]**
