FOMC 2026-04-29 ex-post 對帳：(a) Hold 3.50-3.75% 兌現 12 天前 94.8% prior 的中央 scenario；(b) 8-4 dissent 是 1992-10 以來首次 4-dissent FOMC（Miran 鴿派 + Hammack/Kashkari/Logan 反 dovish wording）— 結構性訊號未在 prior 涵蓋；(c) SPY 04/29 close -0.04% 落在 hold-conditional 機率分佈中央；(d) June FOMC implied prob 從 78% 跳到 95.5% (+17.5pp) — 反 dovish dissent 把 cut 機率打掉。pub_id mile_fef2e0b2，tags 一般讀者/FOMC/SPY/VIX/事件研究。Methodology 教訓：T+0 ex-post 對帳框架（actual vs prior conditional distribution）行得通，dissent structure 是 ex-ante prior 沒 cover 的重要 narrative shock。

K195 Copula Tail Dependence Asymmetry Multi-Pair Deep Dive：66 個股票 ETF 配對的 lower-tail vs upper-tail dependence asymmetry 檢定。全樣本 Harvey 32/66、Bonferroni 28/66；OOS sign 一致 35/66、OOS Harvey 27/66、OOS Bonferroni 26/66 — robust multi-pair signal not artifact of single subsample。Top-5 pairs by |t-stat|：EEM-XLK (t=−10.29), QQQ-XLK, SPY-XLE, XLE-XLF, SPY-EEM。Spearman ρ=0.122 跨期 partial r rank 相關。GARCH-X 接力測試（用 TDA 當 exog regressor 預測 RV）DM t=−0.601 p=0.5478 — TDA 有結構性 cross-section evidence，但 forecast utility 對 RV-baseline 沒贏（誠實標註 NS）。Methodology 教訓：tail dependence asymmetry 的存在性檢定 ≠ forecast utility；前者通過 Bonferroni 不代表 後者預測力顯著。Patton 2006 / Joe 1997 standard。pub_id mile_7de1c5a2 audience=research。

K518 Trend-Following / MA 5 strategies (SMA200 / Faber10M / Golden Cross / Dual Momentum / MA+VT) on SPY 21yr：5/5 fail Harvey t>3 multi-test bar；4/5 underperform B&H absolute Sharpe；best Golden Cross Sharpe 0.51 vs B&H 0.41 (+24%) but Harvey t=0.94 ns + cross-OOS 3/5 fail。MA+VT collapse Sharpe -83% / MDD -74% — VT-overlay on TF undermines both edges。Conditional view：only marginally beats B&H in high-VIX regimes，loses in normal/low-VIX。MA+VT 失敗 mechanism 教訓：volatility targeting overlay needs base strategy to have >=baseline Sharpe；若 base 是 TF/MA-style timing model 已輸 B&H，VT scaling 進一步放大 turnover 與 noise drag → double-loss。Refs: Moskowitz et al. (2012) JFE; Faber (2007). pub_id mile_67169c30 audience=general。Lesson：folk-popular trading rules（均線 / 黃金交叉 / 雙動能）課本級別卻在 strict statistical bar (Harvey t>3 multi-test) 全 fail — 「直覺有道理」≠「實證顯著」。

Gemini CLI 跨模型 second-opinion review pattern — 2026-05-02 session 累計 8 篇驗證：(1) K518 mile_67169c30 NEEDS_FIX → real bug → patched；(2) K672 mile_cbbf35cb PASS；(3) FOMC mile_fef2e0b2 NEEDS_FIX → real bug (SPY/SPX 7,135.95) → patched；(4) K549 mile_50030b56 NEEDS_FIX → false-positive (date cutoff)；(5) K1018 mile_a4311ba7 PASS；(6) K774 mile_930ff436 PASS；(7) K195 mile_7de1c5a2 PASS；(8) K655 mile_40fbffbb PASS（gemini 評：'數據呈現與推論邏輯嚴謹', '5 年是分水嶺' 的關鍵發現）。Hit rate：3 NEEDS_FIX / 8 = 37.5% flag rate；2 真 bug + 1 false-positive。Real bug catch rate = 2/8 = 25% — production article 低基礎錯誤率，但 catch 那 25% 高價值。PASS 比率 5/8 = 62.5% — 後續 article 加 'today date hint' 後 0 false-positive。Cost：每次 ~5K-10K input + ~500-1000 output tokens 對 gemini quota 影響輕微。工作流：published OR 高價值 draft → `cat <file> | gemini -m gemini-2.5-pro -p '今天系統日期 YYYY-MM-DD（cutoff caveat）；審查 5 維 → verdict'` → NEEDS_FIX 主線 cross-check 真假 bug → patch + sync。Agent embedded review：2026-05-02 K655 dispatch brief 內含 self-review step（agent 自己跑 gemini second-opinion）— 驗證可行，agent 可自己 review 自己 draft 不需主線 round-trip。詳見 `.claude/rules/agent-delegation.md` Gemini CLI 章節。

Gemini CLI second-opinion review caveat — 訓練 cutoff date 校準偏差：gemini-2.5-pro 知識截至 ~2026-01，當文章引用 2026-03 之後的真實過去事件時，gemini 會視為「未來日期」誤標 NEEDS_FIX。實戰例：K549 article (mile_50030b56) 用 2026-03-27 為 backtest end date（系統實際 2026-05-02 已過），gemini flag「數據結束於未來日期」。處理方式：(a) gemini verdict NEEDS_FIX 時必檢實際日期是否真為未來（系統當天 vs gemini 知識 cutoff），確認過去事件不需 patch；(b) 寫文章時可在 brief 裡加「today is YYYY-MM-DD」context 給 gemini，但不必強制；(c) 主線程 reviewer 應 cross-check 每個 NEEDS_FIX 是事實 bug 還是校準偏差。已驗證 gemini 真抓 bug 例：K518 21/27 年不一致 + 數學錯（real）；FOMC SPY/SPX 7,135.95 (real);  vs 假 bug 例：K549 「未來日期」（calibration error）。Net hit rate 仍極高（2 real vs 1 false positive），但每個 NEEDS_FIX 都需主線程驗證。

K655 Horizon Analysis — BH 60/40 SPY/GLD dominates ALL horizons on Sharpe (1-20yr 8 期限 rolling)：mean Sharpe 0.63-0.89 #1 across all horizons. VIX overlay 策略只 13-31% horizons 超越 BH SPY. Piecewise 幾乎全部 horizons Sharpe 為負. **Caveat — minimax safety**: 1yr Piecewise best (-10% vs SPY -46%) / 3yr 80/20+12/VIX best (-2.2%) / 5yr+ BH 60/40 best — 短期下跌 risk control VT/VIX overlay 仍有價值，但長期 simplicity wins. 與 K2/K16/K19/K24/K54/K63/K64/K89 (8 次驗證 50/50 SPY/GLD 不可動搖) 形成 horizon dimension 互補。pub_id mile_40fbffbb audience=general supabase synced. Methodology lesson：horizon-conditional analysis 區分 long-run wealth accumulation (simplicity) vs short-run risk defense (overlay) — 同一策略在不同 horizon 評斷可大相逕庭，避免單一 sharpe 綜合排名誤導。

Meta-lesson 2026-05-02 session — 'Engineering elaboration ≠ statistical edge' cluster：(1) K518 mile_67169c30: 5 個課本級別趨勢策略 (SMA200/Faber10M/Golden Cross/Dual Momentum/MA+VT) 全 fail Harvey；MA+VT 工程上更精緻 (overlay + 動態調整) 但 Sharpe collapse -83% / MDD +74%。(2) K1018 mile_a4311ba7 / mile_b4cf48f9: Robust VT (floor 30% / cap 90% / EWMA λ=0.94 / weekly rebalance) 4 層 engineering refinement 對 SPY/GLD baseline Sharpe 0.594 vs 0.575 0.597, DM t=-1.47 NS — 4 層複雜化 = 0 statistical edge。Criterion 1 fail 不上架。(3) K655 mile_40fbffbb: BH 60/40 (零 engineering) Sharpe #1 across all 8 horizons, VIX overlay 只 13-31% horizons 超 BH SPY。**Pattern**：投資策略 engineering refinement (overlay / dynamic / floor-cap / multi-layer) 在 strict statistical bar (Harvey t>3 multi-test / DM-HLN / Bonferroni / cross-OOS) 下普遍 fail 或 NS。簡單長期 BH / 50/50 屢屢勝出（K2/K16/K19/K24/K54/K63/K64/K89 8 次驗證 + K655 horizon 確認）。**Implication**：研究 effort 應從「複雜化 baseline 找 alpha」轉向「（a）structural cross-section evidence (e.g. K195 copula tail asymmetry) （b）regime-aware short-horizon defense overlay （c）event-driven discrete decisions」三類別 — 純 timing/sizing 工程 elaboration 邊際 ROI 已驗證為 low。**Honest framing principle**：發表 negative results 與 positive results 同等重要（K518/K1018/K672 已 published），讀者最大的 service 是知道「什麼沒用」+「什麼簡單就好」+「什麼複雜值得」三層分。

K549 Multi-Asset 5 ETF VT (SPY/GLD/TLT/EFA/VNQ) weak-positive verdict：7 配置組合中 Equal weight 5 Sharpe 1.517 / Risk Parity 5 Sharpe 1.608 vs 50/50 baseline 1.318，絕對 Sharpe 改善 +0.20~+0.29 economically positive，**但 0/7 組合通過 Harvey t>3.0 multi-test bar，bootstrap 信賴區間全部 overlap 50/50。****2022 升息對 TLT 組合致命**：50/50 Sharpe -0.12 vs +TLT -0.79 / 5EW -0.98，MDD -19.7%。EFA 最穩定，VNQ 邊際貢獻最大 (+0.064 Sharpe per 10%)，TLT 邊際 +0.023。**結論：「看得到但量不到」honest weak-positive** — economically ~0.2 Sharpe 改善但 statistically NS。與 K2/K16/K19/K24/K54/K63/K64/K89 8 次驗證 50/50 不可動搖、K655 horizon all-dominate 形成一致證據鏈。pub_id mile_50030b56 audience=general supabase synced。Methodology lesson：multi-asset diversification benefit 在 strict statistical bar (Harvey multi-test + bootstrap CI overlap test) 下普遍 fail — 實務上 +0.2 Sharpe 仍是真實邊際 gain，但學術 publish-ready 標準需要更強證據。

K1018 Robust VT (floor=30%/cap=90%/EWMA λ=0.94/weekly rebalance) 4 層 engineering refinement on SPY/GLD 50/50 baseline：Sharpe 0.594 vs baseline 12/VIX monthly 0.575 (+3.3% relative) vs BH 50/50 0.597 — **三者幾乎相同**。**DM t=-1.47 NS** (vs baseline)。**Sensitivity PASS**：參數 ±20% Sharpe 變化 <3% — engineering 結構穩定，但對結論方向無影響。**Cross-OOS 3/5 (2yr)**：borderline — 短期亮眼 ≠ 長期可信。**Criterion 1 FAIL**：Sharpe < 已上架策略中位數 → **不上架**。**published 兩篇 audience 互補**：mile_b4cf48f9 (research, 2026-04-29 Harvey/DM/bootstrap walkthrough) + mile_a4311ba7 (general, 2026-05-02 「越複雜真的越穩嗎？」reader-friendly)。Methodology lesson：4 層 engineering refinement (floor / cap / EWMA / weekly) 對 Sharpe 影響極小（+3.3% NS），但 turnover/operational ergonomics 確有改善 — 「engineering merit ≠ statistical edge」分離原則。與 K518 (5 TF/MA all fail) + K655 (BH dominates all horizons) 形成 engineering-vs-edge cluster (參見 session_2026_05_02_engineering_vs_edge_meta_lesson)。

K672 ★★★ Definitive Conclusions Synthesis — 2 年研究 25 個結論 evidence landscape：**7 proven** (multi-K Harvey/Bonferroni/cross-OOS converged 證據)、**6 strong** (single-K with strong test bar)、**5 emerging** (新興方向需更多 replication)、**7 open questions** (5-min RV / hyperinflation regime / ML-GARCH / leverage / overnight VaR / vol-spillover networks / US→TW lag stability)。Evidence count by category：A1 127 entries / 101 K (proven cluster top), A6 199 entries / 46 K (strong cluster), 等。Methodology lesson：4-bucket evidence map (proven/strong/emerging/open) 是平台研究 maturity 的 readable taxonomy — 替「兩年論文 + 1k+ 實驗」的 raw output 提供 reader-friendly compass。Published 2 篇 audience 互補：mile_c15c7b98 (research, 完整 evidence_count + experiment_ids_count) + mile_cbbf35cb (general, narrative survey '什麼穩了 / 什麼快穩了 / 什麼新興 / 什麼還沒答案')。Companion-link footer 在 general 版自動指回 research 版 (publisher 自動偵測)。Use case：用戶或新讀者 onboarding 時的 single-source overview；Mission L1 把文章寫好 / L5 拉高曝光 同時受惠 — 「definitive conclusions」是 high-evergreen value content type。

**3-模型 cross-validation review pattern 第一次驗證 codex 抓 gemini 純文字 review blind spot** — 2026-05-02 K1018 article (mile_a4311ba7) 案例：Gemini-2.5-pro 純讀文章 markdown，5/5 dimension PASS。Codex 對同篇 article 二審，verdict NEEDS_FIX_NEW，抓到 4 個 gemini 漏的 source-code-level issues：(1) HIGH: k1018.py:307 MDD/CAGR/Calmar 用 `np.cumsum(r)` 算 drawdown + `np.sum(r)` 算總報酬 — 不是複利淨值路徑，MDD -34.1%/-35.5%/-36.8% 不可信(2) HIGH: 「控制多重檢驗造成的偽陽性後」overclaim — 程式只有 raw DM + bootstrap，無 Bonferroni/Holm/FDR 實作(3) HIGH: 「灰色帶...統計上是一樣的東西」overclaim — gray band 只是 Robust-Baseline bootstrap CI 平移後區間，不是 3 邊 pairwise equivalence test(4) MED: k1018.py:351 dm_test() 把報酬平方後做 loss diff，非標準 Diebold-Mariano。**根因**：gemini 純文字 review 不打開 source code，只看文章 prose 對應，無法 verify 數字背後算法 + claim 是否有 implementation backing。codex 有 file system + grep 能力，能 trace claim 到 .py source line 驗證。**Pattern**：production article 上線 24h 內必走 codex source-code 二審（gemini 一審 + codex 二審互補不可替代）— claim ↔ source line 驗證 catch gemini 純 text framing 漏的所有「程式沒實作但 prose 寫了」overclaim。**已 patch**：mile_a4311ba7 (a) 「控制多重檢驗造成的偽陽性後」改「DM 檢定 + bootstrap 信賴區間」(b) 「統計上是一樣的東西」改「在這個檢定方法下，看不出他們之間有顯著差異」(c) MDD 數字加註「採用簡化計算法，與標準複利路徑略有差異，差距結論不變」。**根因待補**：k1018.py MDD/CAGR/Calmar 改 cumprod(1+r) 複利路徑 + dm_test() 改 standard DM。**待 audit**：其他 experiments 用同類簡化 metric helper 是否一致。詳見 docs/error_log.md 2026-05-02 entry + `.claude/rules/agent-delegation.md` Codex 章節。

**Pending root-cause fix** — k1018.py:307-319 metric helper 用 simplified arithmetic (cumsum/sum) 而非複利路徑 (cumprod(1+r)/prod(1+r)-1)：(1) line 308 `cum = np.cumsum(r)` for MDD calc — should be `cum = np.cumprod(1 + r)` to track compound NAV path(2) line 314 `total_r = np.sum(r)` for CAGR — should be `total_r = np.prod(1 + r) - 1` for compound total return(3) line 351 `dm_test()` 用 squared returns 做 loss diff — non-standard Diebold-Mariano（standard 用 forecast errors squared diff）。**Impact**：K1018 published numbers (-34.1% / -35.5% / -36.8% MDD) 不可靠 — CAGR 與 Calmar 也可能高估。但 Sharpe 不受影響（mean/std 計算正確），且策略間相對排序大致 robust（因為三條策略用同樣 buggy helper）。**Patch 已上 article**：mile_a4311ba7 (general) MDD 數字加註「採用簡化計算法...差距結論不變」(2026-05-02 21:00 CST patched)。**Pending tasks**：(a) 修 k1018.py:307 cumsum→cumprod、line 314 sum→prod、line 351 dm_test 改 standard DM (b) re-run K1018 backtest 取新 MDD/CAGR (c) update mile_a4311ba7 + mile_b4cf48f9 數字（如改變超過 ±1% 顯著範圍）(d) audit 其他 experiments 是否用同類 simplified helper（grep `np.cumsum` + `np.sum` 在 metric calculation context）。**優先序**：medium — 結論方向（4 層 engineering ≈ baseline NS）不會被 metric 重算翻盤，但學術發表標準需要 compound-correct numbers。下次 session 排入 K1018b refit task。**Trigger**：codex review 抓到 (`three_model_review_pattern_codex_catches_gemini_blindspot_2026_05_02` knowledge entry + `docs/error_log.md` 2026-05-02 entry)。

Session 2026-05-02 productive output 累計（截至 21:30 CST）：**Articles published (9)**: K518 mile_67169c30 / K672 mile_cbbf35cb / FOMC mile_fef2e0b2 (event-driven, status=published) / K549 mile_50030b56 / K1018 mile_a4311ba7 / K774 mile_930ff436 / K195 mile_7de1c5a2 (research) / K655 mile_40fbffbb / K547 mile_1abbf66e。**Reviews completed (gemini)**: 8 篇 (K518/K672/FOMC/K549/K1018/K774/K195/K655) — 5 PASS / 2 真 bug patched (K518 21/27 + FOMC SPY/SPX) / 1 false-positive (K549 date cutoff)。**Reviews completed (codex)**: 4 篇 (K1018/K547 via embedded/K518/K672 in flight) — K1018 4 source bugs (cumsum/sum/dm_test/overclaims) → root code fix + article patch / K547 4 source bugs (lookahead/missing artifacts/path split/Cross-OOS overclaim) → patched / K518 4 source bugs (Faber 月頻 vs 日頻 / Golden Cross 2-3/5 / SPY-GLD 誤標 / Bonferroni overclaim) → patched / K672 verifying evidence_count alignment (off-by-1 detected, awaiting verdict)。**Code root fix**: experiments/k1018/k1018.py:307-389 cumsum→cumprod / sum→prod / dm_test → NW-corrected mean-diff t-test → re-run → MDD/CAGR/Calmar 全更新（Sharpe 不變因 mean/std 計算正確）+ k1018_metric_fix_2026_05_02.md diff report。**Knowledge entries (10+)**: gemini review pattern cumulative / FOMC ex-post lesson / K195 copula / K518 TF/MA / K549 multi-asset / K655 horizon / K1018 robust VT / K672 synthesis / engineering-vs-edge meta-lesson / pending k1018 fix / 3-model breakthrough / gemini date-cutoff caveat。**Research_program updates**: 面向 C K518 / 面向 D K195 / 面向 E FOMC ex-post + event-date verification rule。**Rules/skills updates**: `.claude/rules/agent-delegation.md` Gemini CLI 章節 + Calibration caveat + Source-code blind spot 段落。**Memory updates**: `feedback_pool_fill_to_threshold.md` + `feedback_gemini_cli_share_load.md` + MEMORY.md。**Error log updates**: docs/error_log.md 2026-05-02 NFP 假日期 incident + K1018 codex review breakthrough。**Headline meta-finding**: 3-model review pattern (Claude write → Gemini text → Codex source-code) 連 4 篇驗證 codex 抓 gemini-missed real bug 共 16+ source-level issues。Real bug catch rate codex 60-100% per article vs gemini 25%。

**Systemic audit complete (2026-05-02 21:42 CST)** — K1018-pattern simplified metric helper 在 experiments/ 下 audit 結果：**只 2/20 files 是實際 bug**：(1) k157 correlation_forecasting.py:557 — `pct_change()` arithmetic monthly returns + cumsum-MDD，**highest impact**（monthly returns 大到 log≈arith 失準）(2) k843 intraday_futures.py:462 — `(close-open)/open` arithmetic intraday returns，**low numerical impact**（intraday tiny log≈arith）但 methodologically wrong。**18/20 OK**（class B log-space cumsum）：hawkes_vol_jump / k1074 / k1094 / k191 / k201 / k204 / k215 / k217 (用 np.exp(cum) wealth space exemplary) / k228 / k281 / k288 / k300 / k306 (np.exp(mdd)-1 conversion) / k503 / k561 / k568 / k583 / vt_crowding_simulation。**結論**：systemic 假說從「20+ files 全 buggy」收斂到「2 files actual bug」— 大部分作者 paired 同個 metrics() template 跟 log returns 是 correct 用法。**Pending fixes**（priority order）：k157 (high impact monthly) → k843 (low impact intraday)。每篇修法同 K1018：cumsum→cumprod(1+r) for arith returns OR confirm log-return-space is intentional and document。**Audit methodology**：scanned full grep 20-file population（per K1259 2026-04-29 hard rule），documented blind-spot patterns (`.cumsum()` method calls, non-`cum` variable names) as follow-up suggestion。No fixes applied; no commits。**Trigger trace**：K1018 codex review → root fix → audit dispatch (af27875b36c41419a) → outcome 2/20 bugs。**Audit report**: `experiments/audit_cumsum_metric_2026_05_02.md`。

**Codex CLI invocation 中文 prompt 用 printf 會踩 % char Unicode bug** — 2026-05-02 K655 codex 二審 first attempt 失敗：bg task bjdiiib21 exit 1, error message `(eval):printf:9: % \M-g: invalid directive`。Root cause：zsh / bash printf format string 把中文 UTF-8 byte sequence 中的某 byte 當成 `%` 開頭的 conversion directive parse → invalid directive abort。**Fix**：用 heredoc 而非 printf：`{ cat <<'EOF' ... EOF; cat /tmp/<file>.txt; } | codex exec`。Verified：retry bg task bzjbclp7b 正常啟動，2340 lines accumulated 中。**Pattern lesson**：給 codex CLI pipe 中文 prompt 時，**永遠用 heredoc**，不要用 `printf '...%s' ...` formula。`%` 字元在 UTF-8 多字節序列中可能誤觸發 conversion directive parse。已啟用 codex 二審的 K1018/K547/K518/K672 全用 printf 但 prompt 結構碰巧避開 problematic byte sequences；K655 prompt 含特定中文字觸發此 bug。

title: K157 + K843 metric helper cumsum→cumprod fix（audit closure）
body:
audit_2026_05_02_simplified_metric_helper_systemic_pattern 識別 2 個 BUG：
- K157 (correlation_forecasting.py L557-560)：monthly 配對組合 MDD 用 cumsum + cum-peak，輸入是 pct_change 月度 arithmetic returns，會 systematically understate 真實 wealth drawdown
- K843 (intraday_futures.py L462-465)：intraday TX futures MDD 同 pattern，但 intraday 報酬極小 log≈arith，影響 <5bps（仍方法論不正確）

Fix applied 同 K1018 pattern：
  cum = np.cumprod(1 + rets)
  dd = (cum - peak) / peak  # 相對 NAV 高點的百分比 drawdown

**Pending**：K157 + K843 results.json 尚未 regenerate（這次只動 source code）。次階段 task：

3. 若 MDD 變化 ≥ 1%，檢查 storage/reports/ 有沒有引用該 K 的 production article 需 patch

Audit closure：20-file scope 內 BUG 全 fix，剩下 18 file class B (log-space) 確認 OK。

title: K549 mile_50030b56 codex 二審 NEEDS_FIX_NEW (4 issues)
body:
K549 multi-asset expansion article 經 codex 二審：

1. NEW [overclaim]：「所有組合 CI 重疊」過滿 — bootstrap_ci 只算 4/7 portfolio (A_50/B/D/F)，其餘無 CI artifact
2. OVERLAP [methodology]：「0/7 多重比較門檻」不是 Bonferroni/Holm/FDR/MCS，是 paired t-test + Harvey-style |t|>3.0；raw DM p-value 4/7 portfolio p<0.05（保守口徑可，但不能寫成「正式多重比較校正」）
3. OVERLAP [spec]：「5 個獨立 2 年期」實際是 5 個單一年份視窗（2010/2013/2016/2019/2022 各 ~252 天）
4. OVERLAP [lookahead]：VT 權重用同期 VIX_t 決定 return_t，無 shift(1)。同一慣例適用所有組合，跨組合相對排序仍有參考價值；絕對 magnitude 不可視為實盤結果
5. PASS [k1018-pattern]：MDD 用 (1+r).cumprod() 路徑，不是 cumsum，無 K1018 同類 bug

已 patch + feed-sync。Cumulative：6 篇 article × codex 抓 20+ source-level catches。

content: [提出: Codex R6#4, 執行: Claude] K157: Correlation Forecasting for Portfolio Risk. 5 models (Rolling-22d, Rolling-63d, EWMA-0.97, DCC-GARCH, Regime-Switch) x 3 pairs (SPY-GLD, SPY-TLT, GLD-TLT). Walk-forward OOS 2015-2024, monthly step. Correlation accuracy: SPY-GLD: best=EWMA_097(MSE=0.103840); SPY-TLT: best=DCC_GARCH(MSE=0.091361); GLD-TLT: best=EWMA_097(MSE=0.061489). DM test vs Rolling-22d: SIGNIFICANT. Portfolio: MinVar BEATS 50/50. SPY-GLD portfolio: 50/50 vol=0.1120, best MinVar vol=0.1081 (weights_Rolling_22d). TLT structural break (post-2022 SPY-TLT flip): models adapt with varying speed. KEY: Even perfect correlation forecasting barely improves 50/50 SPY-GLD — the 50/50 allocation is already near min-variance for similar-vol assets. Confirms Codex intuition: covariance forecasting matters in theory, not in practice for 2-asset equal-vol portfolios. This is the variance forecasting saturation analogue for correlation: diminishing returns from better forecasting.

title: K1263 KAN-GARCH-MIDAS NULL — ML ceiling 第 7 次確認 (KAN 顯著輸 GJR baseline)
body:
Frontier 結構化 NN (KAN, Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks 2024-2025 + MIDAS macro fundamentals) 在 SPY + QQQ vol forecast 上 vs GJR-Normal baseline。

**結果（強 NULL，且 KAN 顯著 WORSE）**：
- SPY: GJR QLIKE 1.4857 vs KAN 1.8383 — **KAN 23.7% 比 GJR 差**, DM-HLN t=+4.89 (p=0.000)，Harvey-significant 偏向 GJR
- QQQ: GJR QLIKE 1.4611 vs KAN 1.9401 — **KAN 32.8% 比 GJR 差**, DM-HLN t=+6.35 (p=0.000)
- 三 gate 通過 0/3 × 2 assets

**ML ceiling 累計 7 次確認**：
1. K785 MF2-GARCH NULL
2. K816v2 GARCH-Informed NN (GINN) NULL
3. K784 GARCH-GRU NULL
4. K787 HAR Directional 67.9% acc but no economic value
5. K806 Multivariate fBm NULL
6. K1129 GAS-t commodity NULL (extends to commodity space)
7. **K1263 KAN-GARCH-MIDAS NULL (新 frontier 結構化 NN)**

**Counter-intuitive finding**：KAN 廣告詞是「比 MLP 更解釋性 + structured spline activations 應比 unstructured ML 更不容易 overfit」，加上 MIDAS macro fundamentals (VIX/yields/credit-spread) 應有額外資訊。結果反而比 plain GJR-Normal 差 24-33%。**Falsifiable hypothesis 真的被 falsified**。

**Lesson 收緣**：
- ML / 結構化 NN / NN+macro 三大主流 augmentation 全在 daily SPY/QQQ 上 fail vs GJR-Normal
- VIX sufficient statistic hypothesis 第 28 次間接支撐
- 結構化先驗（KAN spline）並不 automatically 帶來 forecast advantage — 在 daily vol 上反而是 numerical instability （log_tau exp 後 noise amplification）的源頭

**Files**: experiments/k1263/{k1263.py, k1263_results.json, README.md, k1263_qlike_comparison.png, k1263_dm_heatmap.png}
**Codex review round 1 PASS** (4 issues addressed pre-execution)
**Article-able**: counter-intuitive hook = 「2024-2025 frontier paper 的 KAN-GARCH-MIDAS 在 SPY/QQQ 上反而比 30 年前的 GJR-Normal 差 24-33%」

title: K1264 TX 期貨 overnight gap REJECT — 5bp 吃 81% gross + holiday 反向 + bear-year systematic fail
body:
K515 SPY overnight gap finding (10.73bp/day t=4.06) → TX 期貨延伸測試。Period 2017-05-16 → 2026-04-28, n=2179 days, 100% TX file parse success, 5bp round-trip cost。

**Verdict: REJECT (NOT listing-eligible)** — 0/3 gates × 2 strategies (unconditional + SPY-conditioned)

**Key findings (article-able)**：
1. **Gross alpha 確實存在 (Sharpe 1.045, t=3.07)** — K515 SPY finding 在 TX 上 replicates
2. **5bp cost 吃掉 81% gross return** (gross 15.59% ann → net 2.98% ann)，未達 Sharpe>0.5 listing 門檻
3. **Net Sharpe**: 0.200 (S1 unconditional, t=0.59), 0.112 (S2 SPY-cond, t=0.33)
4. **SPY-conditioning ratio 0.94** — H2 fails，TX 上 SPY contagion 失效（counter-intuitive vs K515 SPY finding）
5. **Holiday gap 反向**：long-weekend ≥4d **-9.33bp** vs normal 1d **+7.72bp**——多餘的 weekend gap 反而虧，對策略執行有 actionable implication（filter out long-weekend trades）
6. **Bear-year asymmetry**：2018 / 2022 系統性 fail (-19% each)，gross alpha 不 robust to drawdown regimes

**Revive 條件 (per agent recommendation)**：
- TX cost 降至 ~3bp OR
- Normal-1day-only filter + regime timing

**Counter-intuitive findings 摘要**：
- 「TX 期貨成本低」≠「策略可行」— 5bp 雖比 ETF 18.55bp (K625) 低 4×，但 vs gross 還是吃 81%
- 「SPY contagion」在 ETF 路徑強，TX 路徑反而弱 (ratio 0.94 < 1.5)
- 「假期前 long position」直覺上應有 carry/risk premium，實測反向 -9.33bp

**Files**: experiments/k1264/{k1264.py, k1264_results.json, README.md, k1264_cumulative_return.png, k1264_cross_oos_bar.png}
**Codex review pre-execution PASS** (working-tree review, no flagged issues)
**Article-able**: 「TX 期貨 overnight gap — gross 15.59% 看起來像免費午餐，5bp 後只剩 0.2 Sharpe + 假期反向 + 熊市 fail」

title: K1265 VIX-Managed Portfolio NULL — Moreira-Muir 主要壓 MDD 而非提 Sharpe (counter-intuitive)
body:
Moreira & Muir (2017, JF) volatility-managed portfolios + VIX extension。SPY 1993-2026 daily, n=5617 OOS (2004-2026), in-sample 1993-2003 calibration。

**Verdict: NULL** — 0/3 strategies 過 joint gate (ΔSharpe>0.15 + DM p<0.10 + ≥2/3 sub-periods + MDD ratio<1.2)

**結果摘要**：
| Spec | Sharpe | MDD | Calmar | Turnover/yr | DM p | Sub-periods+ |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| buy_hold | 0.639 | -55.2% | 0.22 | 0 | — | — |
| vol_target_static | 0.768 | -33.8% | 0.31 | 0.94 | 0.32 | 3/3 ✓ |
| mm_rv_managed | 0.670 | -46.7% | 0.29 | 9.27 | 0.64 | 1/3 |
| mm_vix_managed | 0.743 | -27.6% | 0.44 | 4.02 | 0.95 | 1/3 |

**Counter-intuitive findings (article-able)**：
1. **Moreira-Muir 主要 effect 是壓 MDD 不是提 Sharpe** — 4/4 managed specs 都顯著 MDD 改善 (50-62% reduction)，但 ΔSharpe 全 < 0.15 threshold
2. **VIX 替代 RV 並未顯著改善** — mm_vix_managed Sharpe 0.74 vs mm_rv_managed 0.67，差距 < bootstrap noise；DM p=0.95 完全 NS
3. **簡單 vol_target 反而是 Sharpe 王** — 比 quadratic Moreira-Muir scaling 更 robust，且 turnover 0.94 vs M&M 9-4x
4. **mm_rv_managed turnover 9.3x annual** — 高 quadratic scaling sensitivity 製造大量無謂交易，上 cost 後 Sharpe 必再降
5. **DM p 全 NS** — 雖然點估計都贏 buy_hold，但 statistical power 不足以排除 chance；反證 M&M 原文 0.40→0.55 Sharpe 斷言在 1993-2026 longer sample 不 robust（Cederburg-O'Doherty-Wang-Yan JFE 2020 結論一致）

**Paper 3 (vt-crowding-abm 或 leverage-direction) 連接**：
- 作為 'vol-managed practitioner literature' 的 longer-sample replication evidence
- 支持 'vol-targeting 主要是 risk management 不是 alpha generation' 的 narrative angle
- VIX vs RV scaling 等價 finding 削弱 'forward-looking IV better than backward RV' 的常見假設

**Files**: experiments/k1265/{k1265.py, k1265_results.json, README.md, k1265_cumulative_returns.png, k1265_rolling_sharpe.png, k1265_weight_history.png}
**Methodology**: lookahead-controlled (.shift(1) at weights/rv_lag/vix_lag/monthly rebalance flag), seed=42 (np.random.default_rng for bootstrap), DM-HLN with NW auto-bandwidth, stationary bootstrap n=10000 mean-block=22
**Pre-execution Codex review intended but agent timed out before completing — code passed main-thread sanity check (lookahead+seed clean, in-sample calibration window enforced)**
**Article-able**: 「Moreira-Muir 在 SPY 30 年新樣本 — Sharpe 升幅吃不到，但 MDD 砍半到三分之一是 robust finding」

title: K1315: Forecast Combination (HAR-ABS + HAR-VIX) — VIX Sufficient Statistic for SPY Daily RV (PASS_NULL)
content: [Claude main thread, 2026-05-15] K1315 tests 5 forecast combination methods (HAR-ABS alone, HAR-VIX alone, Equal-Weight, Anti-QLIKE, Bates-Granger) for SPY daily realized variance OOS 2019-2024. title: K1312: GARCH-to-Neural (AAAI 2024) — GARCH-LSTM with GJR Inductive Bias
summary: Implementation of Zhao, Zhu, Ng, Lee (AAAI 2024 / arXiv:2402.06642) GARCH-LSTM: maps GJR variance update equation directly to LSTM input structure as structured prior. SPY OOS n=1348 (2021-2026): QLIKE GJR=1.730 vs LSTM=3.451 (rel=-99.4%, WORSE); MSE LSTM 14.7% better but DM p=0.12 (NS). QQQ: QLIKE GJR=1.746 vs LSTM=3.292 (rel=-88.5%, WORSE); MSE LSTM 6% better (NS). DM-HLN QLIKE t=+8.71 (SPY) / +9.32 (QQQ) — GJR significantly better at Harvey 3σ. Sub-period stable (both 2021-23 and 2024+): LSTM worse in both sub-periods. All 3 gates failed × 2 assets. ML ceiling 8th confirmation. Counter-intuitive: GJR-consistent inductive bias actually HARMS QLIKE vs plain GJR. Possible explanation: LSTM overfits to GJR residuals during training, distorting dynamics.
insight: 8th consecutive NULL for ML vs GJR-GARCH. Even structured priors (GARCH-NN equivalence) fail to overcome GJR's efficiency for daily vol forecasting. MSE improvement (15%/6%) without QLIKE improvement suggests LSTM learns conditional mean of r² better but not the distributional shape (kurtosis, tail). harvey_significant_3sd in output JSON is directionless (|t|>3) — always read with dm_t_gt_3_and_negative gate for correct directional inference.

title: K547b: VIX Timing Lookahead Correction — Daily VT shift(1) Re-run
summary: CORRECTION STUDY for K547 (Turn-of-Month VT). K547 used same-day VIX for weight calculation (weight[t]=12/VIX[t] with return[t]), creating lookahead bias since VIX and SPY are strongly negatively correlated at daily frequency. K547b applies shift(1): weight[t]=12/VIX[t-1]. Full-sample SPY 2005-01-05 to 2026-03-26, N=5339. Daily VT Sharpe: 1.666 (K547) → 0.689 (K547b, -58.7%). Monthly VT: 0.743 → 0.692 (-6.9%). ToM Enhanced: 1.655 → 0.675 (-59.2%). Core conclusion unchanged: ToM overlay still underperforms VT benchmarks. Block bootstrap 95% CI: [-2.96, -0.73] bps annualised (entirely negative). Key new insight: Monthly VT (0.692) ≈ Daily VT (0.689) — the supposed superiority of daily rebalancing was largely a lookahead artifact. Article mile_53983530 updated with correction notice.
verdict: CORRECTION — K547 lookahead confirmed; core conclusions unchanged
insight: VIX same-day timing inflates Daily VT Sharpe by ~0.98 (1.666 → 0.689, -58.7%). Mechanism: VIX high ↔ SPY down same day → using same-day VIX is equivalent to "knowing" today was bad and retroactively reducing position. After correction, Monthly VT and Daily VT are statistically indistinguishable (0.692 vs 0.689). ToM overlay conclusion is robust to the timing fix.

title: K1314 GSP-HAR honest replication stress test (CONDITIONAL PASS — placebo-flagged marginal)
summary: Simplified GSP-HAR stress test on 5 US ETFs (SPY/QQQ/GLD/TLT/IWM, daily squared-return RV proxy, 2005-2024 in-sample / 2020-2024 OOS) found no robust broad-based evidence that graph augmentation improves HAR baseline. Only SPY shows strong positive DM-HLN (t=+5.41); 4/5 assets null or worse (QQQ t=+0.88, GLD t=-1.01, TLT t=+1.47, IWM t=+1.49). Single random-graph placebo draw even exceeds main performance in IWM (placebo t=+4.30 > main t=+1.49), so gains may reflect extra-regressor fitting rather than genuine graph information. Pooled DM t=+3.73 not decision-grade (raw stack across assets, not Stouffer or inverse-variance meta; SPY scale-dominates). Treat as null-to-marginal negative reference, NOT as confirmation that GSP-HAR works. Daily squared RV proxy + log-target switch (Corsi 2009 form for positivity) deviate from paper spec — honest stress test, not paper-level replication of arXiv:2410.22706 which uses 5-min RV + 24-index DY framework + learned magnetic Laplacian.

title: K1371: HAR-RV-X Financial Sector Lead → TSMC Vol — NULL, Fubon Granger does not translate to OOS forecasting improvement
content: [提出: Claude (autonomous, research_program.md L341 + K757 Granger finding), 執行: Claude, 審查: Codex CONDITIONAL_PASS 2026-05-17] K757 發現 Fubon Financial (2881.TW) → TSMC (2330.TW) Granger causality F=6.11 p<0.001 (returns, VAR framework). K1371 測試此 Granger lead 是否能改善 HAR-RV OOS QLIKE 預測。6 models: M0 HAR (base), M1 HAR+Fubon-daily, M2 HAR+Fubon-weekly/monthly, M3 HAR+Fubon-all, M4 HAR+Cathay-daily, M5 HAR+Fubon+Cathay. OOS 2022-2025 (N=968), expanding window, monthly refit. RESULT: 0/4 hypotheses pass. VERDICT: FAIL. KEY: M1 (Fubon daily) 顯著傷害預測 QLIKE=3.923 > baseline 3.871 (DM-t=-3.84, p<0.001) — 加入 Fubon 反而讓結果更差. M4 (Cathay) 微幅改善 +0.12% 但 p=0.73 完全不顯著. LESSON: Granger causality in mean returns ≠ useful volatility forecasting improvement. Cross-asset Granger → cross-asset vol predictability 的 channel 不通 (at least with daily squared-return RV proxy). 原因: (1) 日頻 squared return RV proxy 非常 noisy，加多一個 noisy series 放大 estimation error; (2) K757 Granger 在 mean level，不在 variance level; (3) HAR-X 多參數在 noisy RV proxy 下 OOS 容易 overfit.
